jobs.title: Senior/Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking a seasoned Senior/Principal Software Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, and verification of software for advanced missile and guided-projectile systems. In this role, you will be the bridge between flight dynamics theory and real-time embedded execution, owning the software architecture for Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC), managing complex Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) simulation labs, and supporting end-to-end flight test campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. GNC & Embedded Software Development

* Design, implement, integrate, and verify mission-critical missile software, focusing heavily on GNC algorithms, autopilot loops, and flight control laws.
* Translate complex mathematical flight dynamics models into high-performance, deterministic, real-time code.
* Utilize Model-Based Design (MBD) frameworks (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink auto-coding) to transition control algorithms seamlessly into target hardware.

2. Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) & Simulation Management

* Architect, maintain, and expand HWIL test environments, integrating flight computers, inertial measurement units (IMUs), actuation systems, and sensor suites.
* Plan and execute rigorous HWIL test campaigns to validate software performance against simulated aerodynamic threats, target profiles, and environmental disturbances.
* Troubleshoot complex, multi-domain system failures spanning software logic, digital/analog signal interfaces, and physical hardware behavior.

3. Verification, Validation, & Accreditation (VV&A)

* Lead VV&A activities for simulation environments, software-only test beds, and HWIL facilities to ensure high fidelity and traceability to system requirements.
* Develop automated test scripts and regression suites to support continuous integration and rapid deployment of software updates.

4. Pre-Flight Support & Mission Planning

* Collaborate with systems engineering and flight test teams to execute pre-flight activities, including missile flyout predictions, trajectory simulations, and safety analysis.
* Define and optimize Restricted Operating Zones (ROZ), range safety limits, and mission scripts for live-fire or captive-carry tests.

5. Field Deployment & Discrepancy Resolution

* Apply deep flight-dynamics and systems-level knowledge to root-cause analysis, anomaly investigation, and discrepancy resolution during test execution.
* Deploy to remote test ranges, proving grounds, or integration facilities as required to support pre-test checkouts, launch operations, and post-flight data reduction.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Stack**

* Experience: 10+ years of professional software engineering experience specifically within aerospace, defense, or missile systems.
* Education: B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Core Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in C and C++ for real-time embedded environments; familiarity with Python or MATLAB for scripting and analysis.
* Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS): Experience developing safety-critical software on RTOS platforms (e.g., VxWorks, Linux with PREEMPT\_RT).
* Domain Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of flight dynamics, 6-DOF (Degrees of Freedom) simulation, aerodynamics, and control theory.
* HWIL & Lab Equipment: Proven background managing HWIL labs using real-time simulation hardware (e.g., dSPACE, National Instruments PXI/CompactRIO, Speedgoat) and communication protocols (MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/UDP, ARINC 429, RS-422).
* Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with safety-critical software development standards (e.g., DO-178C or equivalent military standards).
* Familiarity with Agile development workflows, configuration management tools (Git, SVN), and requirements traceability tools (DOORS, Jira).
* Hands-on experience with sensor simulation or seeker-in-the-loop (SIL) testing.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to play a key role in the design, development, integration, and qualification of missile electronics, power architectures, and electrical interconnect systems. In this position, you will be responsible for the hands-on engineering of onboard avionics, power distribution, sensor/seeker interfaces, Control Actuation System (CAS) drive electronics, flight telemetry systems, and inertial sensor integration.

You will own hardware across the full lifecycle—from concept design and schematic capture through circuit simulation, physical PCB layout, prototype bringing-up, environmental testing, and flight test support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Electrical Hardware & Avionics Design**

* Design, analyze, and test high-reliability, ruggedized printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) for onboard flight processing, signal conditioning, power conversion, and motor control.
* Develop power supply electronics and power conditioning circuits tailored for high-strain missile environments (utilizing thermal batteries, linear/switching regulators, and protection networks).
* Design motor drive electronics and high-current power stages for electromechanical actuators (CAS) and thrust vector control (TVC) systems.

**2. Subsystem Integration & Interconnects**

* Integrate Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) sensors (Inertial Measurement Units, GPS, altimeters) and seeker payloads with flight computer interfaces.
* Design MIL-spec cable harnesses and interconnect systems engineered to withstand extreme acceleration, vibration, shock, and thermal loads.
* Develop and maintain Electrical Interface Control Documents (ICDs), schematic diagrams, and system wiring topologies.

**3. Signal Integrity, EMI/EMC, & Qualification**

* Implement Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC), and shielding techniques per military standards.
* Perform circuit simulations, signal integrity (SI) analysis, and thermal-electrical derating evaluations for critical avionics components.
* Support and execute environmental qualification testing of electronic assemblies under thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, pyroshock, and thermal shock conditions.

**4. Lab Testing, HWIL, & Field Support**

* Design and build Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), test fixtures, and breakout boxes for laboratory integration and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) testing.
* Perform detailed troubleshooting, failure analysis, and root-cause investigations on hardware anomalies during bench testing, HWIL runs, or field operations.
* Support remote test range campaigns for pre-flight checkouts and post-flight telemetry/data analysis.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Stack**

* **Education:** B.S. in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with 5+ years of experience, or M.S. with 3+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, or high-reliability electronics design.

**IMU & Inertial Sensor Experience:**

* Direct hands-on experience integrating tactical or strategic-grade IMUs (RLG, FOG, or high-performance MEMS IMUs such as Honeywell, Northrop Grumman, or Analog Devices units).
* In-depth understanding of IMU electrical interfaces, clocking/synchronization protocols, dynamic range constraints, and noise-sensitivity characteristics.

* **Circuit Design & Tools:**
  + Proven track record in schematic capture and PCB layout using industry-standard EDA tools (**Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, or Mentor Graphics/Siemens EDA**).
  + Hands-on experience with mixed-signal, analog, high-speed digital, and power conversion (DC-DC) design.
* **Bus Protocols & Interfaces:**
  + Experience implementing standard defense and industrial communication buses (**MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, Ethernet/UDP, CAN bus, RS-422/485, SPI, I2C**).
* **Military Standards & Test:**
  + Working knowledge of key military standards (**MIL-STD-461** for EMI/EMC, **MIL-STD-810** for environmental testing, and **MIL-STD-704** for aircraft/missile power).
* **Security Clearance:** Must hold an **active US DoD Secret security clearance** with eligibility for Top Secret / SCI.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience designing drive electronics for brushless DC (BLDC) motors or actuators.
* Background in ordnance safety design or electronic fuzing (ESAD/ESAF) circuits per **MIL-STD-1901A**.
* Familiarity with RF interfaces, antennas, or telemetry transmitters.
* Basic FPGA development (VHDL/Verilog) or micro-controller firmware integration experience.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Space Ground Systems Engineering team solves the mathematical, physical, and algorithmic problems at the core of next-generation missile defense and fire control systems. We tackle dynamic battle-management challenges: fusing real-time sensor streams into track data, optimizing weapon-target assignment under uncertainty, and feeding high-confidence fire-control schedules back to the warfighter.

#### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Systems Engineer - Machine Learning to join our rapidly growing team in Huntsville, AL or Colorado Springs, CO. In this role, you will be responsible for bridging systems engineering, applied physics, and mathematical and machine learning to solve complex missile defense problems. You will design track-fusion pipelines, build threat-assignment algorithms, and conduct deep sensitivity analyses across complex architectures. This will require proficiency in applied math, physics, and algorithm development using Python or C++, alongside an understanding of sensor data and battle management workflows. If you are someone who moves quickly, loves diving deep into the math behind the system, and can operate autonomously to deliver verified, defensible technical solutions, then this role is for you.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Machine Learning:** Research, develop, and deploy complex machine learning models such as generative ai, reinforcement learning, deep neural networks, physics based neural models.
* **Algorithm Design and Development:** Formulate and solve complex physics problems using mathematical techniques.
  + Ex: Object detection, tracking, and discrimination. Weapon-Target Assignment (WTA), sensor allocation, and fire control scheduling.
* **Sensor Fusion & Tracking:** Work on the components of system architecture that ingest raw/processed sensor data, execute track fusion, and perform threat classification.
* **Parametric & Sensitivity Analysis:** Design, conduct, and defend rigorous trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and parametric evaluations to determine system boundaries and validate performance.
* **Prototyping & Modeling:** Rapidly translate mathematical equations into clean, functional code (Python / C++) to run non-customer-facing modeling, simulation, and algorithm verification.
* **Mission Systems Architecture:** Bridge the gap between low-level physics/threat intelligence inputs and high-level mission outputs.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
* **Experience:** 5+ years of relevant engineering experience

jobs.title: Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

### **About the Role**

As a Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer, you will own the final mile between embedded code development and physical deployment across our global fleet of connected devices. In this hybrid role, you sit at the intersection of build infrastructure, automated validation, and release governance. You won't just run test suites or push buttons on a deployment train—you will architect the continuous integration pipelines, design Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) automation fixtures, define gatekeeping qualification criteria, and orchestrate safe, staged over-the-air (OTA) updates.

You will work closely with firmware engineers, hardware validation teams, and cloud backend developers to ensure that every build that lands on a customer's wall, ceiling, or door controller is stable, secure, and reliable.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle:** Define, maintain, and optimize the end-to-end release pipeline for embedded Linux and RTOS builds across our devices.
* **Build Automated Validation Systems:** Design, build, and scale automated Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) test harnesses to catch regressions before firmware ever reaches external hardware.
* **Set Quality & Gatekeeping Standards:** Establish clear go/no-go qualification gates, track test flakiness, and lead triage for release-blocking bugs alongside core firmware developers.
* **Orchestrate Safe Deployments:** Drive staged fleet rollouts, canary deployments, and automated telemetry monitoring to catch field anomalies early and execute fast rollbacks when needed.
* **Drive Developer Productivity:** Build tools and CI/CD automation that speed up firmware compile, packaging, and local test cycles.
* **Self-motivated problem solver:** At Verkada, you will tackle large, complex edge-case bugs spanning silicon, firmware, networking, and cloud services with no clear answers.
* **Teach and learn:** You will take technical ownership of major validation systems while collaborating with and mentoring peers across software, firmware, and hardware engineering.

### **What You Bring**

* BS or graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of experience in software/firmware build infrastructure, embedded test automation, or release engineering.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, scripting, and test framework development.
* Working knowledge of C/C++ in embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
* Hands-on experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, TeamCity) for embedded systems.
* Experience with automated test execution on physical hardware targets (HIL testbeds, serial/UART logging, JTAG/SWD, network power switches).
* Understanding of modern version control workflows (Git branching models, tagging, release trains) and build systems (Yocto/BitBake, CMake, Make, Bazel).
* Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week at our San Mateo HQ.
* Must be willing to travel at least one week a year to our engineering office in Krakow, Poland.

### **Nice to Have**

* Working knowledge of Go.
* Experience with secure boot workflows, cryptographic firmware signing, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation.
* Familiarity with over-the-air (OTA) update frameworks and dual-partition (A/B) fallback mechanisms.
* Experience monitoring fleet health telemetry (DataDog, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK).
* Knowledge of standard embedded communication interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet) and Wi-Fi/cellular networking.

### **US Employee Benefits**

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

* Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
* Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
* Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee's 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary
* Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
* Expanded mental health support
* Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
* Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Secure Systems
jobs.description:
**GROW WITH US AND STAY EXTRAORDINARY:**  
Launch your career to new heights with Innoflight—one of San Diego’s fastest-growing Aerospace and Defense innovators. Here, visionary minds engineer the future of space technology through pioneering, compact, and cyber-secure solutions. From software-defined radios to cutting-edge cryptographic systems and avionics, everything we build powers the next era of New Space. Join our small, agile, and mission-driven team where your work has real impact and your growth has no limits. We’re not just reaching for the stars—we’re engineering them. Let’s innovate the infinite, together.  
  
**A DAY IN THE LIFE:**  
As a **Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Cyber (secure systems),** you will design, develop, and integrate advanced cyber secure embedded software solutions for satellite avionics and payload data processing systems. You will collaborate closely with Systems, Hardware, and FPGA engineers to deliver highly secure, rugged, reliable, and Low-Size, Weight, and Power (Low-SWaP) aerospace products. You will also provide technical mentorship and Subject Matter Expert (SME) level guidance to development and test teams.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Design and Develop Embedded Software:** Design and implement embedded software for multi-core processors integrated with FPGAs (e.g., Xilinx, Microsemi, Microchip, Vorago).
* **Develop for Processor Architectures:** Create software for ARM Cortex and RISC-V processor architectures using C/C++.
* **Configure Linux and RTOS Systems:** Customize Linux kernel, system settings, bootloaders (U-Boot, GRUB), and implement real-time operating systems (RTOS).
* **Implement Secure Networking Protocols:** Develop RFC-compliant networking and security protocols such as IP, TLS, and IPsec.
* **Integrate Hardware Interfaces:** Work with interconnect standards including SPI, I2C, UART, GPIO, PCI, PCIe, Ethernet, and SpaceWire.
* **Apply Cryptographic Systems:** Utilize AES, RSA, ECDSA, and ECDH to develop secure software solutions.
* **Lead Software Development and Testing:** Oversee the development and testing of reusable, high-quality embedded software modules.
* **Ensure Secure System Best Practices:** Establish best practices in Architecture, Design, and Code to maintain system security.
* **Translate Complex Requirements:** Convert system and customer requirements into robust software designs.
* **Interpret Government Security Standards:** Apply government security standards relevant to Innoflight product design and development.
* **Support Software-Hardware Integration:** Assist with integration and debugging on hardware platforms.
* **Manage Software Configuration:** Track features, defects, and releases via formal configuration and release processes.
* **Drive Continuous Improvement:** Contribute to the enhancement of development practices and team workflows.
* **Mentor Junior Engineers:** Provide mentorship through design reviews, code walkthroughs, and technical guidance.

**YOU’RE AWESOME AT:**

* **Embedded Software Development:** Expert in C/C++ for embedded systems and low-level driver development.
* **Linux and RTOS Configuration:** Skilled in embedded Linux kernel, bootloader customization, and real-time OS development.
* **Secure Communication & Hardware Integration:** Experienced with secure networking protocols and hardware interfaces like SPI, PCIe, and Ethernet.
* **Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to mentor junior engineers and lead software development teams effectively.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 9+ years of experience developing embedded software.
* Advanced proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems.
* Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, kernel configuration, and bootloaders.
* Strong understanding of RTOS and real-time constraints.
* Experience interpreting schematics and hardware documentation for driver development.
* Proficient in networking and communications protocols with secure communication standards.
* Familiarity with cryptographic principles and embedded security applications.
* Experience in software integration, debugging, and system-level validation.
* Familiarity with parallel-processing frameworks such as OpenCL or CUDA is a plus.
* Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Proven mentoring and collaborative skills.
* Active U.S. Security Clearance required.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:**  
The starting base salary for this position ranges from **$170,000 to $215,000 per year**, depending on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a competitive base salary, Innoflight offers a well-rounded compensation package that includes a Profit-Sharing Bonus and a Cash Performance Bonus to reward both individual and company performance. Additional benefits include:

* 401(k) with 3% company match (automatic enrollment)
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, HSA & life insurance
* 10 paid holidays + 120 hours PTO (starting in year one)
* Access to ancillary benefits such as critical illness, accident, disability, legal and pet insurance.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:**

* **Flexible Work-Life Balance:** Enjoy a 9/80 work schedule with every other Friday off—whether you use it to recharge, work on a passion project, or spend time with family, the choice is yours.
* **Continuous Learning & Development:** We’re serious about professional development. From tuition reimbursement to internal "Ask Me Anything" sessions and weekly “Lunch & Learns,” we make learning a core part of the job.
* **Mission-Driven Culture:** We aren’t just building tech—we’re enabling the next era of space exploration. Our Culture Ambassadors help lead initiatives around inclusion, positivity, recognition, and transparency. Here, your voice is heard, your work is respected, and your individuality is celebrated.

**BE YOU, WITH US:**  
At Innoflight

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Constellation is creating the AI-human translation layer that ensures humanity evolves alongside our technology. Our mission is to leverage AI towards addressing deep and meaningful problems at the core of the human experience: empowering people towards their goals, augmenting our cognition and emotional wellness, and understanding ourselves and each other. Our path forward is to move away from AI that captures human knowledge towards AI that truly understands what it is to be human. We are generating the richest multimodal dataset ever collected to build a new class of foundation models and we're seeking the founding team of engineers to build the infrastructure that makes this ambitious future a reality.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to own the hardware behind our data collection. Our multimodal collection rigs combine biosensors with video and audio capture, and every stream has to stay synchronized and running, session after session. Your job is to keep that growing fleet of rigs synchronized, healthy, and repeatable, and to build the custom hardware and firmware that make it work better.

This is a generalist role on a small founding team, spanning analog electronics, embedded firmware, and the software glue between devices and our data pipeline. It's research hardware, not volume manufacturing: we move quickly to answer questions, then make what works reliable enough to run every day. You'll work closely with our data collection team, software engineers, neuroscientists, and researchers.

We're hiring at multiple levels and will set title and scope to your experience.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Keep our fleet of collection rigs synchronized and healthy: integrate and maintain off-the-shelf devices, such as biosensors, cameras, and audio equipment, and diagnose failures quickly.
* Own time synchronization across every device and data stream.
* Build reliable, documented rigs, test fixtures, and automated validation that let researchers focus on the science.
* Design and bring up custom boards and sensor integrations where you determine off-the-shelf equipment falls short, from schematic and PCB layout through assembly and testing.
* Write and debug C/C++ firmware for microcontrollers and Python tooling for device control, signal-quality checks, and data validation; work with the Linux drivers on our capture machines.
* Partner with our software team on the interface between devices and our data ingestion infrastructure.
* Handle light mechanical work: enclosures, connectors, mounts, and 3D-printed parts that keep hardware durable and comfortable for participants.
* Decide what to build in-house versus contract out, and manage vendors and contractors when we do.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of experience designing and bringing up electronic hardware, with significant hands-on work in both board design and embedded firmware.
* A track record of building physical things that worked in real use: instruments, devices, or research rigs.
* Able to work independently, make sound technical calls, and explain trade-offs clearly to non-hardware teammates.
* Hands-on experience with biosignals (e.g., EEG, ECG, EMG) or other low-noise measurements, including electrode contact, noise sources, grounding, and shielding.
* Schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium or KiCad, including mixed-signal boards.
* Strong C/C++ skills for writing microcontroller firmware (e.g., on ARM Cortex-M, ideally with an RTOS such as Zephyr or FreeRTOS). Comfortable going below the application layer on Linux to debug device drivers, USB and serial issues, and kernel behavior when hardware misbehaves.
* Python for test scripts, device control, and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience synchronizing data across multiple devices (hardware triggers, shared clocks, timestamping).
* Comfortable at the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Demonstrably adaptable and excited about finding creative solutions to problems nobody has solved before.
* Passionate about positively impacting the well-being of humanity and not just capitalizing on it.
* You thrive in a high-bandwidth, collaborative environment.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience writing Linux kernel modules or device drivers.
* FPGA or HDL experience (e.g., Verilog, VHDL).
* Prior work with research-grade sensing equipment, such as eye trackers or EEG systems, and with synchronization tools such as Lab Streaming Layer (LSL).
* Familiarity with other physiological sensing, such as fNIRS, EDA, or PPG.
* Medical electrical isolation and safety for equipment used with human participants (e.g., IEC 60601).
* A background in designing wearable, battery-powered, or Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.
* Basic mechanical CAD and 3D printing.
* Interest in neurotech, mental health, or human-AI interaction.

**Benefits**
------------

* Comprehensive, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance with premiums fully covered.
* A renovated, light-filled office with a quirky layout in the heart of San Francisco's Mission District, surrounded by world-class food and coffee.
* Relocation assistance for those joining us in SF and workspace setup stipend.
* Monthly team dinners and outings, plus twice-yearly off-sites and retreats.
* Fully stocked kitchen (snacks!)
* Sponsorship for travel to relevant conferences and regular professional development activities to help you level up.
* A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave with a “soft-landing” transition back.
* Paid time off (PTO)

Compensation Range: $180K - $260K

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

The **Senior Flight Software Engineer** is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves and operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. The team is responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

* Develop reliable flight software that determine how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate throughout the entire mission.

jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  

WORK LOCATION: San Luis Obispo, CA

FLSA STATUS: Exempt

This range reflects a good faith estimate based on the targeted level for the role and typical compensation benchmarks across U.S. locations. Actual compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, geographical location, and internal alignment.

SUMMARY

The Associate Avionics/Firmware Engineer supports the development, integration, and testing of embedded software and avionics hardware used in UAS platforms. This role focuses on learning and applying fundamentals of embedded programming, sensor integration, electronics troubleshooting, and flight-critical firmware development. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate Engineer contributes to firmware development, board bring-up efforts, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and documentation to ensure reliable and safe operation of aircraft systems.

This is a hands-on position ideal for engineers who enjoy embedded development, debugging hardware, working with microcontrollers, and supporting system integration activities across electrical, software, and mechanical teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The following job functions are a basic requirement but are not limited to and may be assigned other duties.

* Develop and modify embedded firmware for sensors, avionics boards, and microcontroller-based systems under close supervision.

* Support integration and testing of avionics components such as power modules, GPS, radios, flight-control interfaces, and onboard computers.
* Help maintain firmware documentation, configuration management, and version control (Git).

* Conduct structured troubleshooting using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and test fixtures.

jobs.title: Battery and Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical-takeoff, long-endurance drones that deliver helicopter-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast.  
  
**The role**  
  
A lead engineer for battery packs and high current distribution in our products. This can include cell selection, architecture, thermal and electrical design, BMS tuning and characterization on the bench. You’ll also play a role in cell and pack vendor relationships, our manufacturing partners, and the safety testing and certification.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Drive pack architecture and future cell evalutions
* Understand and evolve our pack designs including structure, materials, thermal paths, tolerance analysis — and characterize them on the bench.
* Drive BMS hardware architecture, and specify the BMS firmware requirements: what it must do, and how it must fail.
* Own charge control: charger architecture, charge-rate strategy, and the throughput consequences of both.
* Drive battery safety — the analysis, the test campaigns, and the documentation — including UN 38.3 and IEC 62133.
* Lead hardware analysis in support of safety: worst-case circuit analysis, DFMEA, derating, thermal assessment, protection coordination.
* Support Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain through NPI and production ramp.

**What we're looking for**

* Electrical engineering depth with real high-voltage or high-energy battery system experience.
* You've taken a lithium-ion pack from cell selection through to a shipping product.
* BMS electronics experience. Ability to specify architecture options and firmware behavior. History of working with cell monitoring, balancing, protection circuits, isolation measurement.
* Hands-on bench capability: you can instrument a pack, run the thermal characterization, and interpret the data.
* Battery safety test experience
* You anticipate failure systematically — DFMEA, worst-case circuit analysis, derating and stress analysis, thermal margin.
* First-principles thinking and a drive to understand the “why” behind traditional approaches to propulsion, power systems, and even radio technologies.
* This is a hands-on job at a company that is still small. You'll be at the bench, in the shop, on the flight line, and sometimes at a customer site working out why a deployed system is misbehaving — alongside new product development, not instead of it.
* You use AI as a real tool, not a talking point. We want to hear one specific example of something you did with AI that surprised you — a workflow you rebuilt, a problem you came at sideways, an analysis that wouldn't have been worth doing by hand. We care less about which tools you use than about what you've changed about how you work. We're enthusiastic about the leverage and unforgiving about errors.

**Nice to have**

* Both aerospace and automotive high-voltage battery context.
* Charging infrastructure design, and mechanical pack design alongside the electrical side.

**Details**

* Onsite in Santa Clara, CA.
* Compensation range $120-165K

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Thermal and Airflow
jobs.description:
Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. We build smart systems and infrastructure for homes, businesses, and municipalities that transform food scraps from landfill-bound waste into valuable resources, including chicken feed. Tens of thousands of Mill's residential food recyclers are already helping households divert millions of pounds of food scraps every year, paving the way for our upcoming launch of Mill Commercial—the industry's first end-to-end solution for managing, understanding, and preventing food waste in commercial environments (e.g. grocery, restaurants, food services). At Mill, we are passionate about building easy-to-use, beautifully designed technologies that keep food in the food system and out of landfills.

**About this Role**

As a Systems Engineer at Mill, you will help characterize, understand, and improve the performance of our next-generation commercial food recycler. This is a hands-on individual contributor role on a small team. You'll work closely with our test engineers to turn experimental data into clear conclusions, review and draft changes to the Engineering Requirements Document (ERD), and take ownership of specific subsystems from characterization through design improvement. You'll collaborate daily with Mechanical, Electrical, Algorithms, and Product. If you enjoy digging into thermal and airflow data and turning it into better hardware, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with the test engineering team to plan experiments and analyze the resulting data on system parameters such as temperatures, airflow, humidity, and heat transfer. Derive conclusions, quantify tradeoffs, and recommend next steps to improve drying performance, energy efficiency, and throughput.
* Own targeted subsystems (e.g. airflow path, condenser, heater, or drying chamber) end to end: define requirements, characterize performance, identify failure modes, and drive design improvements.
* Review proposed changes to the ERD and draft requirement updates based on test results, field data, and cross-functional input, so that requirements stay current and visible to stakeholders.
* Work with the algorithms and firmware teams to provide the data and system understanding needed to refine control schemes for energy use, drying time, and reliable operation.
* Support mechanical engineers in evaluating and iterating on custom hardware such as mixing paddles, air deflectors, and cutting/shredding components, grounded in test data.
* Help define component requirements (fans, blowers, heaters, sensors, flow meters) and support part selection and evaluation.
* Build reusable analysis tools and clear reports (plots, summaries, test writeups) that make results legible across the team.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of hands-on engineering experience with a thermal, airflow/fluids, or mechanical systems focus. Experience with thermal testing and airflow characterization is strongly preferred; a mechanical design background with strong test and analysis skills is also a great fit.
* Comfortable analyzing time-series test data and communicating findings clearly. Python is preferred, but other tools (R, MATLAB, spreadsheets, AI-assisted analysis) are acceptable.
* Experience writing or reviewing engineering requirements, test plans, or similar technical documentation.
* Familiarity with electromechanical components such as fans, blowers, heaters, valves, and sensors.
* BS in Mechanical, Thermal, Process, Chemical, or a related engineering field.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to present results to engineers across disciplines.
* Able to work independently on an owned area while collaborating closely with a small, fast-moving team.

**Nice to have**

* + Prior experience taking a product or process from prototype toward production.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloudflare Hyperdrive
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations | Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA**

### **About the Role**

The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.

### **Responsibilities**

Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:

* Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.
* Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.
* Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.
* Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.
* The team is geographically distributed across North America.
* You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Manager - Mixed Signal Hardware
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

#### **Electrical Engineering Manager - Mixed Signal Hardware**

As an Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for the delivery of our custom Software Defined Radios. As a team leader you will oversee cradle to grave hardware development: architecture definition, board design, testing, and qualification.

#### **Ideal Candidate**

* An individual who has built and overseen the entire design cycle of FPGA based software defined radios for GEO space telecommunications satellites
* Proven record of delivering custom designed hardware that spans the entire range of signal chain design, integration of FPGAs with high speed data converters, custom power and clocking solutions, and supporting RTL development
* Experience with design and analysis of payloads for satellite communications, including radiation effects within FPGA based systems or highly complex digital devices
* History of leading small teams and mentoring employees, strong communication skills, and ability to make high impact decisions under uncertainty.

#### **Role**

* Lead and develop a team of electrical engineers to design industry shattering software defined radios capable of running complex signal processing algorithms in space!
* Oversee and manage design workflows for highly complex PCBAs with integrated compute, high speed I/O, data converters, and power distribution.
* Architect ultra high-speed mixed signal systems to achieve the most efficient and flexible communications payloads, integrating them with the rest of the spacecraft
* Ensure competitiveness through continuous technical innovation and industry expertise

#### **Requirements**

* B.S. or higher in electrical or computer engineering, or similar technical degree
* 8+ years of professional experience in mixed-signal and high-speed digital hardware design. Examples include FPGAs, high speed data converters, SerDes and high speed serial links, networking, JESD204C
* 8+ years of PCB-level experience designing hardware from concept through production (schematic capture, layout, bring-up, characterization, etc)
* Proven leadership through project management, mentorship, and people management experience
* A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design

#### **Bonus**

* Strong background in mixed signal system performance measurement, design validation, and debugging (EVM testing, spur analysis, multi-carrier measurements, etc)
* Experience simulating high speed digital protocols using Ansys SIwave, Keysight ADS, or similar tools
* Experience with Altium or similar EDA tools for high-density PCB design
* Strong background in digital communications theory and measurement of radio nonidealities (HD, IMD, IQ imbalance, gain ripple, group delay distortion, etc)

**U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required**

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

* **Recruiting Updates:** By opting in, you agree to receive SMS updates, interview coordination, and recruiting communications from Astranis Space Technologies Corp.

* **Opt-Out:** You can cancel this service at any time by replying **STOP**. We will send one final text confirming your unsubscription.

* **Opt-In Again:** To resume receiving messages, reply **START** or **YES**.

* **Support & Rates:** For assistance, reply **HELP** or contact us at coordinators@astranis.com. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies; carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

* **Privacy:** For details on how we protect your data, view our Privacy Policy.

GBL is based in Camarillo, CA.

  

GBL Systems is seeking a Mission Data Analyst to support data collection, analysis, visualization, mission assessment, and data-driven debrief activities supporting Department of War (DoW) test and experimentation activities. The successful candidate will aggregate, correlate, analyze, and visualize data from instrumentation, sensors, mission platforms, operational networks, and distributed test environments to produce operationally relevant insights.

  

**U.S. citizenship and current active SECRET clearance required.**

  

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Collect, process, validate, correlate, and analyze mission, test, instrumentation, and operational data from multiple sources.
* Develop dashboards, visualizations, reports, and analytical products supporting test execution and mission assessment.
* Analyze data from sensors, telemetry, mission platforms, communications systems, and operational networks.
* Support mission replay, event reconstruction, data-driven debrief, and post-event analysis.
* Develop data processing workflows, analytical methodologies, metrics, and performance measures.
* Identify trends, anomalies, operational observations, and performance insights.
* Support development of assessment products, test reports, executive summaries, and customer deliverables.
* Perform data validation, quality assurance, and analytical troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with engineers, operators, test personnel, and Government stakeholders to define analytical requirements.
* Support field events, demonstrations, experimentation, and test execution as required.

This role is a strong fit for someone with a background in mobile equipment controls, mechatronics, electro-mechanical systems, or similar hands-on electrical engineering applications.

* **Mobile Equipment Controls Expertise** – Brings experience designing, troubleshooting, and improving low-voltage DC electrical control systems used in real-world equipment applications.

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for designing low-voltage DC electrical control systems for mobile equipment, including schematics, component selection, prototype support, testing, troubleshooting, and production documentation. This role supports the development of practical, reliable mobile machine control solutions and works closely with internal teams to ensure designs meet customer requirements, quality expectations, and production needs.

This position is well suited for an engineer with experience in mobile equipment controls, mechatronics, electro-mechanical systems, or similar hands-on electrical engineering applications.

**Electrical Engineer – PCB & Hardware Design**

E.I. Medical Imaging

**Position**

Electrical Engineer – PCB & Hardware Design

**Department**

Engineering

**Reports To**

Chief Technology Officer

**Location**

Loveland, Colorado (on-site)

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Exempt

**Experience Level**

Mid to Senior (5+ years)

**Compensation**

$85,000- $145,000 (based on experience) + benefits

**About E.I. Medical Imaging**

E.I. Medical Imaging (EIMI) designs and manufactures the Ibex family of portable, ruggedized ultrasound systems for veterinary use, built for chutes, barns, and pastures around the globe. We are a small, hands-on team where engineers own their work from first schematic through production and field support.

**The Role**

EIMI is looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to own the design of the PCBs used in its systems: architecture, component selection, schematic capture, multilayer layout, bring-up, and release to manufacturing, for current Ibex products and our next-generation platform.

This position is the primary electrical design authority on PCBs, working closely with firmware, software, mechanical, production, and service to deliver hardware that is compact, power-efficient, manufacturable, and tough enough for years of field use.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own board architecture, schematic capture, and multilayer PCB layout for new products and revisions, including library and footprint management.
* Design mixed-signal circuits spanning high-speed digital (processors/SoCs, DDR, USB, PCIe, MIPI), low-noise analog including ultrasound AFE, and power electronics.
* Design battery-powered systems: Li-ion charging and protection, DC-DC conversion, power sequencing, and low-power modes.
* Apply sound SI/PI, grounding, impedance control, and stackup practices, and design for shock, vibration, moisture, temperature, and ESD in harsh field environments.
* Select components for performance, cost, availability, and lifecycle; manage second sources, obsolescence, and accurate BOMs with purchasing.
* Lead prototype bring-up, debug, and design verification, including EMC/EMI, RED/FCC, and electrical safety compliance testing.
* Release complete fabrication and assembly packages using DFM, DFA, and DFT principles, working directly with fab houses and contract manufacturers.
* Support production and service with root-cause analysis on failed boards and field returns, and maintain design documentation and ECOs.

**Required Qualifications**

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 5+ years of board-level hardware design experience, taking multiple products from concept to production.
* Proven ability to independently own both schematic capture and multilayer layout in Altium Designer, OrCAD/Allegro, KiCad, or similar.
* Working knowledge of processor-based designs (ARM SoCs or similar), DDR memory, and high-speed serial interfaces.
* Experience with mixed-signal, power-management, and battery-powered design, including signal/power integrity and stackup fundamentals.
* Hands-on bench skills: bring-up, debug, and fine-pitch SMT/BGA rework.
* Familiarity with EMC/EMI design practices and compliance testing.
* Clear documentation habits and the ability to explain design tradeoffs to non-EE teammates.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ultrasound, imaging, or other high-channel-count analog/data acquisition systems.
* Experience integrating edge AI/ML compute modules into embedded hardware.
* Experience with portable or ruggedized products, and with Wi-Fi/Bluetooth RF layout and antenna integration.
* Familiarity with CE (including RED), FCC, IEC 61010/60601, and quality systems such as ISO 13485 or ISO 9001.
* Experience with FPGA hardware design.
* Experience building a PCB design process, libraries, and design reviews at a small company.
* Interest or experience in AI-assisted hardware design tools (design review, placement and routing, or EDA-integrated assistants), with sound judgment on verifying their output.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 days:** Establish EIMI’s in-house PCB design workflow (tools, libraries, design rules, reviews, and release process), including evaluation of AI-assisted tools.
* **First year:** Take at least one board through prototype into production and become the go-to resource for board issues.

**What We Offer**

* End-to-end ownership of hardware design on products used by veterinarians and producers worldwide.
* Small, collaborative team with direct access to leadership.
* A team that actively uses AI in its engineering work, with room to evaluate and adopt AI-assisted design tools.
* Competitive salary, health/dental/vision, retirement plan, PTO.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a brief cover letter to ptemple@eimedical.com Examples of board designs you have owned (schematics, layout screenshots, or a description of your role) are strongly encouraged.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $145,000.00 per year

* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance

* Vision insurance

This includes expertise in RF/analog design (e.g. impedance matching, simulation, and lab validation) combined with experience in high-speed digital PCB design (e.g. DDR5, 200G ethernet, and PCIe Gen6) and the ability to merge these varied disciplines into a dense multilayer PCB while accounting for the associated power and signal integrity challenges.

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.title: HPC Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**The future of aerospace and defense starts here.**

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

  

**The journey to space starts with the engines.**

Ursa Major is bringing a new model to propulsion and defense technology: one where performance and access are no longer constrained by legacy systems. We design, build, and deploy advanced propulsion systems that power national security missions, hypersonic capabilities, and the future of space access.

Our mission requires an extraordinary team; one that will mold tomorrow's critical technologies while deploying today's best. We are an intrinsically motivated team with a passion for solving complex technical problems and empowering each other every day, knowing that there is always room for growth.

**About The Role**

As a critical member of our Digital Operations team reporting to the IT Manager, the HPC Systems Engineer holds a dual mandate: driving the continuous expansion of our High-Performance Computing (HPC) simulation clusters while serving as IT's core Enterprise Linux Subject Matter Expert.

By taking ownership of our HPC infrastructure, you will directly liberate engineering bandwidth and accelerate propulsion design cycles enabling our solids, liquids, thermal, and structural analysis teams to run complex CFD/FEA workloads faster and at greater scale. Simultaneously, you will partner with IT, DevOps, and Zero-Trust Networking to architect, automate, and harden our enterprise Linux servers across our Colorado and Ohio facilities.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, deploy, expand, and optimize Linux-based HPC clusters, storage systems, and compute nodes supporting mission-critical propulsion analysis.
* Administer job schedulers and resource managers (e.g., Slurm, PBS) to ensure fair-share scheduling, efficient queue utilization, and minimal job latency for engineering users.
* Partner directly with solids, liquids, thermal, and CFD analysis engineers to integrate, benchmark, and optimize commercial and open-source simulation suites (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus) and GPU-accelerated workloads (NVIDIA CUDA).
* Manage high-throughput storage solutions (e.g., BeeGFS, NVMe-oF, NFS) and high-speed network fabrics (InfiniBand / 100GbE) to eliminate data bottlenecks during large-scale parallel processing.
* Act as the primary systems engineer and Level 2/3 escalation point for enterprise Linux systems, hypervisors, and core IT infrastructure.

jobs.description:
*n*Logic is seeking an innovative, creative, and highly motivated **Senior Sustainment Systems Engineer** support a MILSATCOM Program Management Office (PMO) within the US Space Force's (USSF), Space Systems Command (SSC) at Peterson Space Force Base (PSFB), CO.

The candidate will support sustainment activities for a diverse portfolio of strategic and tactical MILSATCOM space systems and infrastructure. The candidate will provide systems engineering and integration expertise in support of legacy space constellations including, but not limited to, Milstar, Advanced Enhanced High Frequency (AEHF) and Enhanced Polar System (EPS) and associated ground infrastructure, warfighter terminals and software applications such as Family of Beyond Line‐of‐Sight Terminal (FAB‐T), Global Aircrew Strategic Network Terminal (Global‐ASNT), Milstar Messaging System (MMS), Global Broadcast Service (GBS) and Ground Multiband Terminal (GMT) along with various other systems, subsystems and devices in a multidisciplinary environment. The candidate will also have a direct impact on new MILSATCOM space systems transitioning from the acquisition community to operational stakeholders.

This opportunity is an engineering management position. We seek a self‐starter who is capable of autonomous, on‐the‐job learning/growth. We seek technical individuals who will thrive by working in a collaborative work environment of small teams tackling the challenges of sustaining complex, space‐based, telecommunication systems. The candidate will have a positive, tangible effect across all aspects of the space system (spacecraft, uplinks/downlinks, command & control, networks, users) while improving overall combat readiness.

The MILSATCOM Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (MSEIT) effort provides leading edge Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I) for the Air Force's Space and Missiles System Center. We support the Air Force's acquisition of state-of-the-art Military Satellite Communications systems, providing global secure, survivable, and protected communications for our nation's warfighters. We seek technical individuals who will thrive in a highly collaborative work environment of small teams, using the most modern tools and methodologies to tackle the challenges of integrating complex space and ground communications systems.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Provides the government customer with MILSATCOM systems engineering advisory assistance, including daily engineering consultation in support of sustainment activities
* Engages the Joint space warfighting community, supporting sustainment tasks through established space systems engineering processes and procedures for requirements development, technical solution generation (hardware and software) and fielding to space warfighters
* Evaluates and produces products of a technical nature using technical rigor, adequacy, completeness, and appropriate application of the specialty engineering disciplines as standard process
* Assists with technology readiness assessments; identify risks and issues with proposed technologies while collaborating with other teams (i.e., Test & Evaluation, Integrated Logistics Support, etc.)
* Supports waiver, deviation and deficiency reviews, system allocations, and compliance assessments
* Conducts system/enterprise level engineering analysis to identify sustainment problem areas; provide impact analysis, forecast potential failures, and present options with potential to mitigate these problems
* Performs engineering analysis on organizational technical processes; suggests process improvements that increase efficiency and/or effectiveness of operations as required
* Supports formulation of relevant information of sustainment objectives and performs engineering analysis and system-level assessments for decision support at various meetings and sustainment forums
* Perform studies and analyses of military air, surface, maritime, space and cyberspace missions to assess integration, system-of-systems factors, system vulnerability and survivability, system commonality, new technologies, enhancements, commercialization, cost effectiveness, and mission assurance

  

**Required Qualifications**

* A DoD Secret Clearance is required to be considered for this position
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, computer science, or equivalent technical discipline
* 5+ years of experience working with military or DoD civilian clients and managing professional relationships
* 4+ years of experience working in a highly competitive multi‐contractor environment
* 5+ years of experience in architecture/requirements definition/analysis, acquisitions, engineering/design, fielding/integration, and verification or analysis
* 4+ years of relevant systems engineering experience
* 4+ years of relevant systems integration experience
* 4+ years of relevant experience engaging government customers to advance projects and initiatives at varying degrees of complexity through engineering management
* Must be able to demonstrate engineering principles and concepts
* Expertise with requirements development and analysis, and the development of systems engineering‐related documents including requirements/specifications, interface control documents, and validation & verification plans
* Solid analytical and problem‐solving skills; able to sort through complex issues and develop clear solutions, provide in‐depth technical assessments and identify issues and risks
* Effective interpersonal and team player skills to engage at both the peer and management levels
* Ability to coordinate with numerous stakeholders/customers from DoD agencies to commercial industry
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project)
* Clear and concise written, verbal communications and presentation skills; able to clearly articulate ideas, recommendations and options to the customer
* Highly organized individual, capable of handling multiple competing priorit

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

About the Role  
This role will be a valued member of a tight-knit engineering team responsible for a variety of types of GNC (guidance, navigation & control) hardware, potentially including GPSR (Global Positioning System Receiver), RWA (reaction wheel assembly), CSS (coarse sun sensor), ST (star tracker), IMU (inertial measurement unit) or MTR (magnetic torque rod), while supporting multiple programs within LM Space. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Space Ground Systems Engineering team solves the mathematical, physical, and algorithmic problems at the core of next-generation missile defense and fire control systems. We tackle dynamic battle-management challenges: fusing real-time sensor streams into track data, optimizing weapon-target assignment under uncertainty, and feeding high-confidence fire-control schedules back to the warfighter.

#### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Systems Engineer - Machine Learning to join our rapidly growing team in Huntsville, AL or Colorado Springs, CO. In this role, you will be responsible for bridging systems engineering, applied physics, and mathematical and machine learning to solve complex missile defense problems. You will design track-fusion pipelines, build threat-assignment algorithms, and conduct deep sensitivity analyses across complex architectures. This will require proficiency in applied math, physics, and algorithm development using Python or C++, alongside an understanding of sensor data and battle management workflows. If you are someone who moves quickly, loves diving deep into the math behind the system, and can operate autonomously to deliver verified, defensible technical solutions, then this role is for you.

* **Prototyping & Modeling:** Rapidly translate mathematical equations into clean, functional code (Python / C++) to run non-customer-facing modeling, simulation, and algorithm verification.
* **Mission Systems Architecture:** Bridge the gap between low-level physics/threat intelligence inputs and high-level mission outputs.

* **Experience:** 5+ years of relevant engineering experience
* Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* **Core Foundation:** Strong mastery of **applied mathematics, physics, and programming**.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Faex Health**

Faex Health turns stool images into gut-health insights. Our platform combines proprietary computer-vision models, color-density analysis, and Felix, our retrieval-grounded AI assistant, to help people track changes over time and to support clinicians and researchers. Faex runs on iPhone and Android in 13 languages across multiple regions. Live features include Faex MD for clinicians, women’s health with a period tracker, a GLP-1 gut-health journey, and partner APIs connecting to care and research ecosystems.

**The Role**

We are hiring a QA automation engineer to expand and formalize our existing test suite and CI. Today we run a Django test suite and browser regression tests, and an Azure DevOps pipeline runs tests and a secret scan on every pull request to our main and release branches. You will strengthen the frameworks, extend coverage across the web app, APIs, mobile apps, and image-analysis pipeline, and make test results part of every release decision. You will work directly with our CTO and developers.

**What You Will Do**

* **Test frameworks.** Expand and formalize our automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing, building on the existing Django test suite, with clear structure, reusable components, and reporting.
* **Azure Pipelines integration.** Extend the Azure Pipelines YAML checks that already run tests and a secret scan on every pull request, publish results, and add quality gates that block failing builds.
* **Azure DevOps test management.** Organize test plans, suites, and cases, using Azure Test Plans where it adds value; log and track defects in Azure Boards linked to stories and builds; keep tests in Azure Repos.
* **Web UI automation.** Expand browser regression tests for the Django web app using tools such as Playwright or Selenium, covering our new Bootstrap 5 interface.
* **API testing.** Test REST and partner APIs, including FHIR-based integrations, authentication, and error handling.
* **Mobile testing.** Test the iPhone and Android apps that wrap our web app, covering photo upload, deep links, sign-in flows, and device differences, using tools such as Appium and cloud device testing.
* **Image-analysis pipeline testing.** Build regression checks that run labeled reference images through new model releases to confirm detection, color-density, and scoring results stay within agreed limits.
* **Release verification.** Run and extend smoke tests after Elastic Beanstalk deployments, building on the /health/ check in our deploy pipeline, and help decide whether to proceed or roll back.
* **Performance testing.** Create load and performance tests for scan processing, queues, and peak traffic, using tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter.
* **Test data and compliance.** Build safe test data using synthetic or de-identified records, never real patient information, and support SOC 2 and HIPAA audit evidence.
* **Quality metrics.** Track coverage, flaky tests, and defect trends, and work with developers to improve testability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in software quality assurance, including 3+ years building test automation.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining an automation framework, not just writing scripts within one.
* Experience running and maintaining automated tests in CI/CD pipelines, triggered on pull requests and releases.
* Strong Python testing skills (Django test framework / unittest; pytest also valuable); experience testing Django or other Python web apps.
* Experience with browser automation using Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Experience with API testing tools and frameworks, such as Django’s test client, Python HTTP clients, or Postman.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD, Git branching, and test strategies such as unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression.
* Clear defect reporting and communication with developers.
* Comfortable working day to day with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Kiro) and quick to pick up new tools as they change.
* Ability to work in the Denver office three days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the Faex app or experience testing health, wellness, or medical software.
* Experience with Azure DevOps: Azure Pipelines YAML, Azure Test Plans, Azure Boards, and Azure Repos.
* Experience with mobile automation using Appium or cloud device testing services.
* Experience testing machine-learning or computer-vision outputs.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter.
* Experience testing on AWS, including Elastic Beanstalk deployments and environment management.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and validating data in tests.
* Experience working under HIPAA, SOC 2, or FDA software quality requirements.
* ISTQB or a similar testing certification.

**How We Work**

* Small team, high ownership: you will set our testing standards, not just follow them.
* Evidence-led: every release decision should be backed by test results.
* Privacy by default: test data must never expose real health information.

Pay: $70,700.00 - $85,300.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greenwood Vlg, CO 80111

Within Disney Signature Experiences, the Disney Cruise Line team delivers end-to-end digital and physical experiences for Guests and Cast Members across shipboard and shoreside platforms. The Lead Software Engineer – Data Architect is a hands-on senior engineer who designs, builds, and governs the software components, APIs, event streams, and data contracts that allow DCL systems across commerce, reservations, mobile, and operational platforms (including Seaware, web, and downstream platforms) to exchange data in a consistent, scalable, and governed manner. This engineer leads the technical design of large, highly sophisticated integration and data-platform solutions, writes and reviews production code assets, and sets the engineering standards that other teams build against.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Own the analysis, design, programming, debugging, and modification of software components and services that integrate DCL commerce, reservation, mobile, and operational platforms in cloud-based, on-prem shipboards and networked environments
* Lead the design and development of APIs, event-driven services, and messaging layers, including the canonical data models, schemas, and payload structures they expose
* Conceive, design, develop, test, and implement software for data exchange between systems, including notification/event payloads, snapshot payloads, and synchronous vs. asynchronous integration patterns
* Define and enforce engineering standards for data contracts, schema versioning, naming conventions, and domain boundaries, and embed them into code reviews, solution architecture reviews, and ARB processes
* Act as the technical authority on data structure and integration design decisions impacting cross-platform systems, providing clear guidance on tradeoffs across latency, cost, scalability, and resiliency
* Build software with privacy, security, and data classification requirements designed in, ensuring compliance with enterprise policies and regulatory requirements
* Promote reusable, modular software and data design that minimizes duplication across platforms and reduces technical debt
* Lead or perform testing and debugging of integration services and data pipelines, identifying root causes and innovative solutions
* Interact with Product, business, and engineering partners to define system requirements and necessary modifications
* Help drive estimation and planning of highly sophisticated, scalable projects and their budget allocations

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field
