jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

**In this role you will**

* Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
* Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
* Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
* Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
* Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
* Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

**Required qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
* Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
* Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
* Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
* Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

**Desirable qualifications**

* ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
* Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
* Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
* Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
* Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Hayward Holdings Inc. (NYSE "HAYW") is one of the leading manufacturers of residential swimming pool equipment in the world, with a significant presence in the commercial pool market that is continuously growing. Hayward designs, manufactures, and markets a full line of residential and commercial pool and spa equipment including pumps, filters, heating, cleaners, salt chlorinators, automation, lighting, safety, flow control and energy solutions at our company owned facilities. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Hayward also has facilities in Tennessee, Arizona, and Rhode Island, Georgia, as well as Canada, Spain, France, Australia, and China.

**Overview:**

We're looking for a self-directed engineer who thrives with ownership — someone who can take a project from concept through manufacturing release with minimal oversight, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver industry-leading pool controls, electronics, and assemblies.

Join us to lead, grow, and make an impact as part of a company that values care, respect, and innovation.

**This position is based in North Kingstown, RI and is onsite 5 days a week.**

**Major Tasks and Responsibilities**

**1. Design Ownership**

* Analyze system and subsystem level requirements and evaluate technical solutions for new platforms.
* Generate electrical architecture solutions, topologies, and configurations to optimize the electrical design for new project needs.
* Design, model, simulate, implement, and verify circuits.
* Lead design reviews, optimize PCB layouts, and specify components for robust designs.

**2. Analysis and Verification**

* Support electronic circuit verification activities per industry accepted practices.
* Support DFMEA and other analyses to develop a robust product that meets market and safety requirements.

**3. Test, Validate, and Launch**

* Build and analyze bench level prototypes for proof-of-concept designs.
* Create and execute test plans to validate designs and ensure industry compliance (HALT, EMC/EMI, UL, CE).
* Partner with manufacturing teams for smooth production launches.

**4. Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with product, firmware, mechanical, and system architects to create cohesive product architectures.
* Maintain detailed technical documentation and communicate design strategies effectively.

**5. Continuous Learning**

* Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies through conferences, research, and side projects.
* Champion and role model best practices within the electrical engineering team.

**Requirements**

Experience: 8–10+ years in electrical design and product development.

**Who You Are**

* Self-driven and independent — comfortable owning projects end-to-end with minimal oversight and a strong commitment to meeting deadlines.

**Required Experience**

* Proficiency with schematic capture tools (Altium, Xpedition, Zuken, OrCAD or Eagle) and knowledge of PCB layout and PCB construction.
* Experience with IoT-connected embedded systems, including wireless communication protocols (e.g., Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee) and cloud-connected device architectures.
* Knowledge of 3-phase BLDC motor drives, embedded systems, microcontrollers, and analog/digital circuitry.
* Familiarity with safety standards, EMC, and environmental compliance.
* Understanding of mechanical/thermal/packaging design for embedded systems in commercial and industrial markets.
* Experience with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, and timing analyzers to support product verification.
* Technical knowledge of reliability testing including environmental, safety, and EMI/EMC verification procedures.
* Working knowledge of display controller and touch-controller interfaces (e.g., RGB, MIPI DSI, SPI, I2C), including backlight drive and power sequencing, touch tuning for wet, gloved, and high-glare conditions, ESD/EMC protection of the display and touch subsystem.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using simulation and analysis tools such as LTSpice, Saber, Mathcad, or Maple.
* Experience with electrical product design in a regulated environment such as automotive, aerospace, or medical.
* Design For Six Sigma, DMAIC, Lean Six Sigma, or Shainin Red X certification.
* Hands-on experience designing and integrating user-interface displays and touchscreens for harsh, outdoor-exposed products, including full-color TFT LCD touchscreens (resistive and projected-capacitive) as well as simpler segmented, character, and LED displays and keypads.
* Proven track record translating customer and market requirements into product requirements, system architectures, and technical specifications.
* Experience leading or contributing to architecture trade studies, make/buy decisions, and platform selection (MCU/SoC, connectivity modules, sensors).

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) required; Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE) preferred.

**Why Join Hayward**

* **Impact at Scale:** Build the connected, IoT-enabled hardware inside smart pool products used in millions of homes worldwide.
* **Our Mission:** Transforming water experiences with innovation and sustainability.
* **Growth Opportunities:** A supportive environment for career advancement and professional development.
* **Inclusive Culture:** We value diversity and foster a collaborative workplace.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive pay, health coverage, retirement plan matching, and paid time off.

**Sensor Autonomy Engineer - Tactical Applications**  
  
**About Overwatch:**  
Overwatch Imaging is an imagery intelligence technology company working to bring sensor autonomy to time-critical airborne search, detection, tracking and monitoring missions. Our Automated Sensor Operator (ASO) software, native to our own line of purpose-built Smart Sensors and as an upgrade for airborne video gimbal platforms, brings Superhuman Vision and Workload Reduction to users of real-time imagery intelligence systems. We fundamentally believe that modern edge processing and AI-enabled autonomy can perform an important set of time-critical imagery intelligence missions better, faster and more safely than humans can alone.  
  
Founded in 2016 in Hood River, Oregon, we support private sector companies as well as federal, state and local agencies around the world with missions ranging from wildfire mapping and disaster response to law enforcement, border security, maritime domain awareness and tactical intelligence.  
  
**Position Description**  
The Sensor Autonomy Engineer will design and implement software and firmware to transform high-level user inputs and raw sensor data into real-time customer intelligence for Overwatch's Tactical Applications products. This engineer works hands-on with prototype and low-rate production automated imaging systems, developing, testing, and deploying real-time onboard sensor autonomy, image processing and artificial intelligence algorithms, embedded hardware drivers, image manipulation software, user interfaces, and data post-processing tools built to perform within the size, weight, power, and latency constraints of tactical operating environments.  
  
**Level Description**  
The Sensor Autonomy Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of complex software applications. They may have a technical leadership role in mentoring and managing teams of junior and mid-level software engineers. They are expected to have a strong technical background, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to make high-level decisions that affect the entire software development process.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Mathematical Modeling & Analysis:**  
  + 3D mathematics, including coordinate systems, vectors, and rotations.
  + Control systems, state estimation, and motion planning.

* **Geospatial Imagery Optimization:**
  + Develop software to geolocate, rectify, mosaic, register, and combine imagery with map data.
* **Software Development:**
  + Design, develop, and maintain complex software applications.
  + Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  + Participate in code reviews, troubleshoot issues, and optimize software performance and functionality.
* **Payload Embedded Software:**
  + Lead code development, version management, and testing for motion control, camera and IMU drivers, and data management.
  + Balance urgent code changes and unit-specific customization with long-term software sustainability and code reuse.
  + Interface with low-level hardware using SPI, I2C, UART, and analog interfaces.
  + Improve error detection, reporting, and mitigation.
* **Software Interfaces:**
  + Develop and maintain connections between Overwatch Imaging payloads and external systems for command and control, external exploitation algorithms, and data export.
* **Software Deployment:**
  + Develop automated build tools to build, test, and deploy software updates while managing dependencies.

**Character Attributes:**  

* Thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced small startup business environment
* Highly motivated self-starter able to work independently and with a team
* Collaborates well in a small team environment
* Enjoys hands-on work and learning new skills
* Eager to learn and solve real-world problems and accept new challenges
* Takes pride in seeing new products reach operational use quickly

  
**Experience and Education:**  
  

* Formal education in software engineering, computer science, aeronautical engineering, robotics, optics or related fields.
* Strong analytical background in physical systems that interact with the real world
* Experience in airborne or space-based remote sensing and image processing; hands-on experience with mid-sized unmanned aircraft and/or airborne camera systems.
* Experience with image processing software, machine learning techniques, and/or autonomous systems.
* Experience with device driver implementation and embedded system deployment.
* At least 8 years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or
* At least 5 years of experience with a Master’s degree, or a Ph.D degree.
* Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

  
**Technical Competence:**  
  

* Strong experience with the following programming languages: C++, Python, CUDA, OpenCV.
* Strong experience with software versioning and branch management and issue/defect tracking systems.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies such as Agile or Scrum
* Knowledge of multithreading, parallel programming, interoperability, and algorithm optimization.
* Knowledge of Control Systems, IMU, and GPS/INS Hardware and Software
* Knowledge of Linux Operating System on GPU-Accelerated Hardware
* Experience integrating AI/agent coding assistants into daily development, and reviewing AI-assisted code with appropriate rigor
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to lead and mentor other software developers
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

  
**What We Offer:**  
  
**Growth Opportunities:** As a team member of a true startup, you will learn by doing and shape our future. The opportunities are limitless for those who want to grow their career.  
**Impact Opportunity:** We work on missions that matter to keep people safe and make the world better, and we do it without bureaucracy at the speed of a startup.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**About us**
============

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore's teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

  

**Job Summary**
===============

We are seeking a Senior Systems or Staff Hardware Engineer to provide advanced operational, diagnostic, and engineering support for Graphcore's Arm-based hardware platforms across lab and data center environments.

This role focuses on supporting hardware bring-up, validation, and troubleshooting of complex AI compute platforms, including server blades, racks, and rack-scale infrastructure. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with engineering, platform, and data center teams to ensure the reliability and performance of next-generation AI systems.

  

**The Team**
============

The Systems Engineering and Hardware Engineering teams are responsible for enabling the bring-up, validation, and operational reliability of Graphcore's AI infrastructure platforms.

The team works closely with server engineering, firmware teams, platform architects, and data center operations to support the development, testing, and deployment of next-generation AI compute systems.

This collaborative environment enables rapid problem-solving and continuous improvement of Graphcore's hardware platforms from early development through production deployment.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**
===============================

* Lead advanced break-fix troubleshooting for server blades, motherboards, power systems, and rack-scale infrastructure.
* Support engineering bring-up activities, including component validation and firmware interaction testing.
* Diagnose system-level failures involving thermal behavior, power anomalies, network configuration, and BIOS/BMC issues.
* Collaborate with server engineering teams to perform root cause analysis and propose corrective actions or design improvements.
* Support deployment and rollout of next-generation hardware platforms through structured validation and qualification cycles.
* Interface with facilities and infrastructure teams to understand environmental factors impacting system reliability.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and validation documentation.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior technicians and engineers on troubleshooting methodologies and hardware diagnostics.
* Participate in on-call rotations or off-hours support during critical engineering milestones or hardware bring-up phases.

**Candidate Profile**
=====================

**Essential**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.
* 7+ years experience with server hardware architectures and board-level debugging.
* Experience analyzing system logs, hardware telemetry, and power/thermal metrics to isolate hardware failures.
* Hands-on experience with HPC systems, AI compute platforms, or rack-scale infrastructure.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in fast-paced engineering environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Desirable**
-------------

* Experience supporting prototype or pre-production hardware bring-up.
* Familiarity with data center facilities, including liquid cooling and power distribution systems.
* Experience using Python, Bash, or automation tools for hardware validation or troubleshooting.
* Exposure to structured failure analysis and reliability engineering methodologies.

  

**USA Benefits**  
  
In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. Our benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, commuter benefits, wellness services and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

jobs.title: Advanced ATE Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As an Advanced Test Engineer here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will play a pivotal role in advancing the quality and reliability of aerospace products through innovative test engineering practices. You will lead the development and execution of sophisticated test plans and procedures, leveraging cutting-edge methodologies to ensure our aerospace solutions meet the highest standards of performance and safety.

You will report directly to our Engineering Manager, and you’ll work out of our Richardson, TX location on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the aerospace industry by ensuring that Honeywell’s aerospace products are rigorously tested and validated, contributing to safer and more efficient air travel worldwide. Delivering mission-critical, electronic solutions that protect lives. Use your creativity and critical thinking to take our products from concept to customer. You will lead the development and execution of sophisticated test solutions for Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits (MMICs). This role involves analyzing detailed test requirements and designing advanced Automated Test Equipment (ATE) systems tailored to customer specifications. The engineer will create and implement comprehensive test strategies, including test plans, acceptance procedures, and rigorous design verification processes.

The position requires leadership in enhancing team test capabilities through planning, coordination, and development of custom test equipment, including fixture design and fabrication. Responsibilities include performing RF test setup, calibration, validation, and troubleshooting of complex assemblies to ensure accurate, repeatable measurements.

The engineer will develop and maintain automated test software using National Instruments LabVIEW, integrating instrumentation and databases to enable scalable, efficient, and high-throughput testing environments. Additional duties include conducting advanced troubleshooting, failure analysis, and root cause investigations for MMIC devices and RF assemblies, as well as executing product qualification and environmental stress testing to meet industry standards.

This role also involves generating detailed technical reports, managing test data systems, and supporting laboratory operations such as asset tracking and equipment maintenance. Precision work under microscopes for inspection, assembly support, and failure analysis are also required. The ideal candidate is highly technical, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

The Electrical Engineer at PROPWR is a member of the PWRLIVE Center, PROPWR’s real-time engineering, field engineering, and asset reliability team. The Electrical Engineering Manager is responsible for leading a small team of electrical engineers, controls engineers, designers, and drafters in the design, development, and implementation of electrical and control systems for amusement rides and devices. This role provides technical leadership, project oversight, resource planning, and process improvement while ensuring compliance with industry standards, functional safety requirements, and regulatory codes. * Lead, mentor, and manage a team of electrical engineers, controls engineers, designers, and drafters engaged in the design and development of amusement rides and devices.

* Assist the Engineering Director with departmental budgeting, resource planning, staffing, and workload forecasting.
* Lead by example through active participation in engineering and design activities while balancing management, planning, and supervisory responsibilities.

* Implement standardized electrical architectures, design practices, and component selection across products to improve reliability, maintainability, and efficiency.
* Promote and enforce the use of functional safety principles and safety-focused design methodologies throughout the engineering process.

* Experience in the amusement ride, theme park, industrial automation, or special machinery indust

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Spacecraft Hardware
jobs.description:
**About Overview Energy**

Overview Energy is a mission-driven team committed to building a new layer of energy infrastructure: satellites in geosynchronous orbit that redirect solar energy to terrestrial solar projects via passively safe near-infrared light. We’re in the earliest phase, where every circuit board and harness that leaves our facility is designed, built, and tested end-to-end by a small, dedicated team. Headquartered in the Northern Virginia / Washington, DC area and backed by world-class investors, we are advancing the next generation of clean energy technology.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the electronics behind our flight and ground hardware. You’ll report directly to our lead electrical engineer and work daily with our mechanical, embedded software, and systems engineers.

This is a generalist seat. One week you’re capturing a schematic and bringing up a new board on the bench. The next, you’re holding a supplier to its statement of work and checking that what ships matches what we specified.

This is built for someone a few years into their career who has already put real hardware on a bench and wants a far bigger slice of the system than a large prime can offer. The role is onsite daily at our Ashburn Virginia facility.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and capture schematics for analog, digital, and power boards: sensors, data acquisition, power delivery, and the interfaces between them.
* Select components, build BOMs, and see boards through fabrication and assembly.
* Bring up new PCBs with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench supplies, then debug and characterize them against requirements.
* Support systems engineering on requirements, architecture, and interfaces.
* Design and document wire harnesses and interconnects: wire gauge, connectors, pinouts, and interface control documents (ICDs).
* Manage electronics suppliers and contractors: review statements of work, track deliverables, and verify what arrives against spec.
* Run power budgets and first-pass thermal and EMI checks, applying derating and space-environment practices to every design.
* Write test procedures and scripts that automate measurements and data analysis.
* Drive hardware anomalies to root cause and close out corrective actions.
* Write complete design reports, ICDs, and test procedures, so the next engineer can pick up your work without a meeting.

**What We’re Looking For From You**

* B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 2–5+ years of hands-on electrical hardware experience. Internships and co-ops count, as does a substantial hardware program such as CubeSat, Formula SAE, solar car, hybrid/EV, rocketry, or UAV teams.
* At least one piece of hardware you designed, built, or tested end-to-end and can walk us through on a whiteboard.
* Solid fundamentals in analog and digital circuits, plus enough embedded experience to work with microcontrollers and common communication buses.
* Schematic capture experience in Altium, KiCad (preferred), or a similar tool.
* Comfort on the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Some experience working with an external supplier or contractor, even a single one on a single program.
* Ability to work onsite at our Northern Virginia facility.

**We Have a Strong Preference For**

* Hardware that has flown, or a full program cycle in space, aerospace, UAV, or another high-reliability field.
* Exposure to environmental testing: vibration, shock, and thermal vacuum.
* Familiarity with circuit design in LTspice or related simulation platforms such as SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, PLECS, or Qspice
* Power electronics or battery system experience.
* Wire harness design and fabrication.
* Range across mechanical, electrical, and embedded work.

The salary band for this position is $110,000 - $150,000 commensurate with experience. Individuals with demonstrated exceptional ability may be considered beyond this band.

**Our Benefits**

We take care of our people. In addition to competitive salary and equity, Overview Energy offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, a health and wellness stipend, 4 weeks paid time off, 2 weeks sick leave, parental leave, and 401(k) matching. Benefits are subject to change at the Company's discretion.

**ITAR Requirements**

This position is subject to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Overview Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at talent@overviewenergy.com.

Research shows that women and individuals from underrepresented groups often only apply for roles where they meet every listed qualification. If you believe you can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply - even if you don't check every box.

From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  
  
Amazon LEO is seeking a Senior Manufacturing And Automation Engineer to develop, automate, and scale manufacturing processes for complex aerospace hardware, including PCBAs, battery packs, LRUs, and associated components. This role is responsible for transforming prototype and manual manufacturing processes into scalable, reliable, and efficient production solutions. The successful candidate will lead manufacturing process development, automation equipment integration, process optimization, and production readiness, ensuring manufacturing systems meet quality, throughput, safety, and cost objectives.  
The ideal candidate combines strong manufacturing process engineering expertise with hands-on experience in industrial automation, equipment design, robotics, and production system integration.

Manufacturing Automation: Design, develop, and implement automated and semi-automated production systems incorporating robotics, PLCs, motion control, machine vision, sensors, and industrial controls.  
  
Equipment and Tooling Development: Define requirements and lead the design, fabrication, integration, and commissioning of manufacturing equipment, fixtures, tooling, and automated assembly stations.  
Process Capability and Optimization: Establish manufacturing process parameters, implement process controls, and apply PFMEA, DOE, SPC, and capability analysis to improve yield, reduce variation, and eliminate defects.  
  
Production Scalability: Develop manufacturing strategies and automation solutions to increase production capacity, reduce cycle time, minimize manual operations, and support production ramp-up.  
Equipment Integration and Qualification: Lead equipment acceptance, commissioning, process validation, and production release, ensuring manufacturing systems meet performance, safety, and reliability requirements.  
  
Manufacturing Troubleshooting: Lead root cause investigations of manufacturing defects, equipment failures, and process inefficiencies, implementing sustainable corrective actions.  
  
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Quality, Test Engineering, and suppliers to improve manufacturability, implement process automation, and transition products into production.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
* Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related STEM field
* 5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, process development, industrial automation, or production equipment development.
* Experience developing and implementing manufacturing processes, automated equipment, or assembly systems.
* Hands-on experience with industrial automation technologies such as PLCs, robotics, sensors, motion control, or machine vision.
* Experience with manufacturing process troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production

**Overview**

Microsoft is the world’s center of expertise on topological quantum computing. We are building a scaled, fault‑tolerant quantum computer grounded in topological qubits and integrated end‑to‑end with the Azure Quantum software stack.

As a **Senior Quantum Systems Electrical Engineer**, you’ll collaborate closely with quantum physicists, systems software, RF/EE, and manufacturing/production to help define, design, and deliver FPGA‑based, ultra‑low‑latency digital subsystems that sit at the heart of our topological quantum engine—spanning readout classification, error‑decoder acceleration, room‑temperature front‑ends for cryogenic control, high‑speed interconnects, and precision clocking networks. Your work will directly impact logical‑qubit stability, throughput, and system scale.

At Microsoft Quantum, we aim to empower science and scientists to solve the world’s biggest problems by realizing advanced computing platforms at the intersection of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and quantum information technology. Microsoft Quantum will change the world of computing and help solve some of humankind’s currently unsolvable problems. For more information about our team, visit https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/quantum.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - MDASH
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate.

The **MDASH team** is reimagining how organizations identify and remediate vulnerabilities in source code. Using AI agents and models, MDASH analyzes code to determine whether potential vulnerabilities are real and reachable, provides developers with actionable fixes, and helps verify that vulnerabilities have been successfully addressed.

We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to help build and evolve the MDASH scanning engine as we work to advance agentic code scanning. In this role, you’ll design and build systems that coordinate AI agents and models to analyze complex codebases, scale across programming languages and frameworks, validate security findings, generate high-quality fixes, and deliver reliable, efficient performance in production environments.

You’ll work closely with security researchers, applied scientists, model teams, and product managers to turn new techniques and evaluation insights into product capabilities. We’re looking for an engineer with experience building complex, large-scale systems, foundational knowledge of application security, and excitement about using AI to solve challenging problems in software security.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Design, build, and evolve the MDASH scanning engine, including agent orchestration, multi-model routing, code understanding, vulnerability detection, reachability validation, and fix generation and verification.
* Extend the engine's coverage across vulnerability classes, programming languages, frameworks, build systems, and codebase sizes, from single services to large monorepos.
* Integrate program analysis techniques into agent workflows to make detections more precise and grounded. These include static and dynamic analysis, taint tracking, call-graph and data-flow analysis, fuzzing, and sandboxed execution.
* Improve the engine's precision, recall, consistency, and fix quality, working from evaluation results, research findings, and production feedback.
* Optimize scan performance, scalability, cost, and latency so MDASH works well on enterprise-scale codebases and in CI/CD workflows.
* Build a secure, reliable, observable engine, with strong isolation for running untrusted code and clear telemetry for diagnosing agent behavior.
* Work with security research, applied science, model, and product teams to bring new techniques and models into the engine quickly and safely.
* Track the agentic security and code-scanning landscape, and bring forward ideas that make MDASH stand out against competitors.
* Write high-quality, well-tested code. Lead design reviews, take part in code reviews and on-call rotations, and help raise the engineering bar for the team.
* Mentor other engineers and model Microsoft values to help build an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.
* Experience building production systems with large language models, such as AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, planning, context management, or code-understanding systems.
* Experience building or working on security scanners, static analysis (SAST), dynamic analysis (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), compilers, or other program analysis tools.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability classes such as memory safety, injection, authentication and authorization, deserialization, path traversal, SSRF, and business-logic flaws.
* Experience with program analysis techniques such as taint analysis, data-flow and control-flow analysis, code property graphs, fuzzing, or symbolic execution.
* Experience building distributed, high-scale cloud services on Azure, including containerized or sandboxed execution.
* Familiarity with multiple software ecosystems and build systems across C/C

jobs.title: Senior Security Software Engineer EDR
jobs.description:
The Detection team within Apple Services Engineering (ASE) is responsible for finding any threat actors attacking approximately three quarters of Apple's systems and services. We do this by partnering closely with engineering teams to build a deep technical understanding of how their systems work, and a comprehensive understanding of the threats against them.  
  
A growing part of that mission is the endpoint detection and response (EDR) technology we build ourselves. It is a Swift-based agent that runs on Linux (x86 and ARM64) and on Apple operating systems running on Apple silicon. It collects security telemetry, evaluates detections directly on the host, and takes response action on the host. It also supports Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the system that extends the privacy and security of Apple devices into the cloud and runs the larger models behind Apple Intelligence. Most of your work will be on Apple's own internal servers, and some of it supports public-facing products used by hundreds of millions of people.  
  
**Description**  
  
We are looking for an exceptional engineer to help us grow this agent to protect a very large fleet, and to do it without ever taking production down. You will bring two things at once: the engineering depth to ship new capabilities quickly, and a reliability mindset that treats every release as something that runs on production hosts. You will take vague, high-stakes problems and turn them into working software, working with other teams to find out what to build and how. This is not a role where you will be handed pre-defined tickets.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience building or operating endpoint, host or agent software deployed at large scale, with performance and availability objectives.  
  
Experience with eBPF, EndpointSecurity or similar OS-level instrumentation, and an understanding of how those mechanisms can be evaded or disabled.  
  
Experience with Swift on server, concurrency in Swift, and cross-platform builds.  
  
Understanding of EDR or host-based detection techniques and the current industry state of the art.  
  
Experience with policy-driven detection logic (for example OPA/Rego), and with statistical techniques such as probabilistic data structures for bounded-memory anomaly detection.  
  
Experience with virtualization and hypervisor environments.  
  
Experience building CI/CD and release tooling for software deployed to hosts, including staged rollout and rollback.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
7+ years of professional experience building, shipping and supporting production software or system software.  
  
Personal proficiency, in at least one high-level or scripting language (Python or Rust) and at least one low-level systems language (C or C++).  
  
Solid knowledge of operating system internals (processes, threads, memory, system calls, namespaces). Linux, macOS or both.  
  
Credible understanding of attacker behavior and security concepts, and of how malicious activity shows up in host telemetry such as process, network and file events.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $308,500, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

**Job Summary**

The Electrical Engineer will support gas, coal, renewable, and new-generation self-build projects by defining electrical design-basis requirements and supporting the technical specification, engineering, procurement, integration, and commissioning of power generation electrical systems. A required focus of this role is advanced knowledge of utility-scale power plant electrical systems and equipment, including generators, generator step-up transformers (GSUs), medium- and low-voltage distribution systems, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), protective relaying, grounding systems, black-start systems, auxiliary power systems, and grid interconnection requirements.  
This role collaborates with Architect & Engineering (A/E) and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure electrical designs meet performance, reliability, maintainability, constructability, safety, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements. The engineer will participate in RFx/OEM engagements, support self-build proposals, and provide construction, commissioning, startup, and lifecycle support across the generation portfolio.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support development of electrical design-basis and equipment requirements (generators, transformers, switchgear, station service, UPS/DC, cabling).
* Assist with power system studies and data preparation (load flow, short‑circuit, protection coordination, arc‑flash, harmonics) under senior review.
* Review vendor drawings, technical bids, and RFx deliverables and prepare comments for senior engineers.
* Help prepare technical and procurement specifications and scope documents for proposals.
* Support OEM interfacing during procurement: submittal review, factory/field testing coordination, and lead‑time tracking.

* Ensure designs comply with relevant codes and standards (IEEE, NEC/NFPA70, ANSI, IEC) and assist with reliability/obsolescence tasks.

Job Description
  
  
**Job Title:** AI/ML Software Engineer, Fairbanks Morse Technology
  
  
**Reports To:** Electrical and Controls Engineering Manager
  
  
**Location:** Beloit, WI (full-time, on-site)
  
  
Summary
  
Fairbanks Morse Technology’s goal is to create secure, mission-driven, advanced, and reliable technology solutions through artificial intelligence, digital technology, smart engineering solutions, automation, and Advanced IoT Solutions.
  
  
FMT is looking for an AI/ML Software Engineer to design and build complete software products from customer requirements. This is a developer role for someone who can gather and write down what the customer needs, then build the full application that meets it, and who designs it so it can be reused and expanded to other equipment, customers, and use cases.
  
  
This rolls will focus is applying AI/ML to predictive maintenance, root cause analysis, and driving action to fix the problem automatically, starting with U.S. Navy shipboard equipment. We are looking for someone who uses AI development tools safely and effectively to deliver working products quickly.
  
  
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Work with customers and stakeholders to gather requirements, document them clearly, and turn them into a technical plan.
* Design and build full applications (backend, APIs, data pipelines, and user interface) that meet those requirements.
* Architect products to be modular and reusable so they can expand to other assets, customers, and situations without a rewrite.
* Develop and deploy AI/ML solutions for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis.
* Connect detection and diagnosis to action by building workflows that recommend or trigger the fix, such as guided maintenance, work orders, or automated responses.
* Use AI coding assistants and tools to build and iterate quickly, while reviewing, testing, and securing all AI-generated work.
* Integrate with sensors, controllers, historians, and customer or third-party systems, including in disconnected edge environments.

* Demonstrate work to customers and stakeholders and keep them informed of progress and risks.
* Any other duties as the job requires.

Qualifications and Educational Requirements
  
Required
  

* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including full-stack or full-application delivery from requirements through deployment.
* Proven ability to take an unclear customer need, define the requirements, and deliver a working, tested product.
* Strong Python and at least one other language such as C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or C++.
* Experience building REST APIs, data pipelines, databases, and web user interfaces.
* Hands-on experience applying machine learning in production, such as anomaly detection, classification, or time-series analysis, using tools like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
* Experience using AI coding tools to speed up development, with sound judgment on testing, code review, and protecting sensitive data.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, and a major cloud platform (Azure preferred).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical trade-offs to customers and leadership.
* Ability to work independently and quickly in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
* This position requires access or potential access to Unclassified Naval Nuclear Propulsion Information, which is Not Releasable to Foreign Nationals (NOFORN) data. Therefore, to meet NOFORN requirement, you will have to provide proof of US Citizenship and attest that you do not have dual citizenship. Acceptable proof of US Citizenship is a US Passport, US Birth Certificate or Naturalization Certificate.

Preferred
  

* Experience with predictive maintenance, condition-based maintenance (CBM+), or prognostics and health management.
* Experience with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic workflows.
* Experience with industrial data sources and protocols such as PLCs, OPC UA, Modbus, or MQTT.
* Experience supporting U.S. Navy or Department of Defense programs, including Azure Government Cloud and RMF, STIG, and NIST requirements.
* Edge or embedded deployment experience on disconnected hardware.
* Cross-platform mobile development experience (for example .NET MAUI).

Contract Administration: **Review customer purchase orders, specifications, technical requirements, and contractual obligations.**

Codes and Standards Compliance: **Apply NFPA 70, NFPA 79, and NFPA 86 requirements to electrical design, control panels, equipment interfaces, and safety circuits.**

Technical Coordination: **Coordinate PLC/HMI hardware requirements and work with Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, vendors, and programming resources.**

Technical Collaboration: **Work closely with the Electrical Engineering Manager of Aichelin Americas and the GMO of UPC Marathon on technical requirements, engineering priorities, and project execution.**

Manufacturing / Startup Support: **Support control-panel fabrication, equipment manufacturing, testing, installation, startup, commissioning, and customer acceptance as required.**

Reporting to Management: **Provide project updates covering schedules, financial performance, technical issues, customer concerns, risks, and actions requiring management support.**

new_jobs.title: Senior/Principal Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking a seasoned Senior/Principal Software Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, and verification of software for advanced missile and guided-projectile systems. In this role, you will be the bridge between flight dynamics theory and real-time embedded execution, owning the software architecture for Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC), managing complex Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) simulation labs, and supporting end-to-end flight test campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. GNC & Embedded Software Development

* Design, implement, integrate, and verify mission-critical missile software, focusing heavily on GNC algorithms, autopilot loops, and flight control laws.
* Translate complex mathematical flight dynamics models into high-performance, deterministic, real-time code.
* Utilize Model-Based Design (MBD) frameworks (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink auto-coding) to transition control algorithms seamlessly into target hardware.

2. Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) & Simulation Management

* Architect, maintain, and expand HWIL test environments, integrating flight computers, inertial measurement units (IMUs), actuation systems, and sensor suites.
* Plan and execute rigorous HWIL test campaigns to validate software performance against simulated aerodynamic threats, target profiles, and environmental disturbances.
* Troubleshoot complex, multi-domain system failures spanning software logic, digital/analog signal interfaces, and physical hardware behavior.

3. Verification, Validation, & Accreditation (VV&A)

* Lead VV&A activities for simulation environments, software-only test beds, and HWIL facilities to ensure high fidelity and traceability to system requirements.
* Develop automated test scripts and regression suites to support continuous integration and rapid deployment of software updates.

4. Pre-Flight Support & Mission Planning

* Collaborate with systems engineering and flight test teams to execute pre-flight activities, including missile flyout predictions, trajectory simulations, and safety analysis.
* Define and optimize Restricted Operating Zones (ROZ), range safety limits, and mission scripts for live-fire or captive-carry tests.

5. Field Deployment & Discrepancy Resolution

* Apply deep flight-dynamics and systems-level knowledge to root-cause analysis, anomaly investigation, and discrepancy resolution during test execution.
* Deploy to remote test ranges, proving grounds, or integration facilities as required to support pre-test checkouts, launch operations, and post-flight data reduction.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Stack**

* Experience: 10+ years of professional software engineering experience specifically within aerospace, defense, or missile systems.
* Education: B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Core Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in C and C++ for real-time embedded environments; familiarity with Python or MATLAB for scripting and analysis.
* Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS): Experience developing safety-critical software on RTOS platforms (e.g., VxWorks, Linux with PREEMPT\_RT).
* Domain Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of flight dynamics, 6-DOF (Degrees of Freedom) simulation, aerodynamics, and control theory.
* HWIL & Lab Equipment: Proven background managing HWIL labs using real-time simulation hardware (e.g., dSPACE, National Instruments PXI/CompactRIO, Speedgoat) and communication protocols (MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/UDP, ARINC 429, RS-422).
* Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with safety-critical software development standards (e.g., DO-178C or equivalent military standards).
* Familiarity with Agile development workflows, configuration management tools (Git, SVN), and requirements traceability tools (DOORS, Jira).
* Hands-on experience with sensor simulation or seeker-in-the-loop (SIL) testing.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to play a key role in the design, development, integration, and qualification of missile electronics, power architectures, and electrical interconnect systems. In this position, you will be responsible for the hands-on engineering of onboard avionics, power distribution, sensor/seeker interfaces, Control Actuation System (CAS) drive electronics, flight telemetry systems, and inertial sensor integration.

You will own hardware across the full lifecycle—from concept design and schematic capture through circuit simulation, physical PCB layout, prototype bringing-up, environmental testing, and flight test support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Electrical Hardware & Avionics Design**

* Design, analyze, and test high-reliability, ruggedized printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) for onboard flight processing, signal conditioning, power conversion, and motor control.
* Develop power supply electronics and power conditioning circuits tailored for high-strain missile environments (utilizing thermal batteries, linear/switching regulators, and protection networks).
* Design motor drive electronics and high-current power stages for electromechanical actuators (CAS) and thrust vector control (TVC) systems.

**2. Subsystem Integration & Interconnects**

* Integrate Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) sensors (Inertial Measurement Units, GPS, altimeters) and seeker payloads with flight computer interfaces.
* Design MIL-spec cable harnesses and interconnect systems engineered to withstand extreme acceleration, vibration, shock, and thermal loads.
* Develop and maintain Electrical Interface Control Documents (ICDs), schematic diagrams, and system wiring topologies.

**3. Signal Integrity, EMI/EMC, & Qualification**

* Implement Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC), and shielding techniques per military standards.
* Perform circuit simulations, signal integrity (SI) analysis, and thermal-electrical derating evaluations for critical avionics components.
* Support and execute environmental qualification testing of electronic assemblies under thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, pyroshock, and thermal shock conditions.

**4. Lab Testing, HWIL, & Field Support**

* Design and build Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), test fixtures, and breakout boxes for laboratory integration and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) testing.
* Perform detailed troubleshooting, failure analysis, and root-cause investigations on hardware anomalies during bench testing, HWIL runs, or field operations.
* Support remote test range campaigns for pre-flight checkouts and post-flight telemetry/data analysis.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Stack**

* **Education:** B.S. in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with 5+ years of experience, or M.S. with 3+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, or high-reliability electronics design.

**IMU & Inertial Sensor Experience:**

* Direct hands-on experience integrating tactical or strategic-grade IMUs (RLG, FOG, or high-performance MEMS IMUs such as Honeywell, Northrop Grumman, or Analog Devices units).
* In-depth understanding of IMU electrical interfaces, clocking/synchronization protocols, dynamic range constraints, and noise-sensitivity characteristics.

* **Circuit Design & Tools:**
  + Proven track record in schematic capture and PCB layout using industry-standard EDA tools (**Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, or Mentor Graphics/Siemens EDA**).
  + Hands-on experience with mixed-signal, analog, high-speed digital, and power conversion (DC-DC) design.
* **Bus Protocols & Interfaces:**
  + Experience implementing standard defense and industrial communication buses (**MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, Ethernet/UDP, CAN bus, RS-422/485, SPI, I2C**).
* **Military Standards & Test:**
  + Working knowledge of key military standards (**MIL-STD-461** for EMI/EMC, **MIL-STD-810** for environmental testing, and **MIL-STD-704** for aircraft/missile power).
* **Security Clearance:** Must hold an **active US DoD Secret security clearance** with eligibility for Top Secret / SCI.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience designing drive electronics for brushless DC (BLDC) motors or actuators.
* Background in ordnance safety design or electronic fuzing (ESAD/ESAF) circuits per **MIL-STD-1901A**.
* Familiarity with RF interfaces, antennas, or telemetry transmitters.
* Basic FPGA development (VHDL/Verilog) or micro-controller firmware integration experience.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

new_jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Machine Learning
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Space Ground Systems Engineering team solves the mathematical, physical, and algorithmic problems at the core of next-generation missile defense and fire control systems. We tackle dynamic battle-management challenges: fusing real-time sensor streams into track data, optimizing weapon-target assignment under uncertainty, and feeding high-confidence fire-control schedules back to the warfighter.

#### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Systems Engineer - Machine Learning to join our rapidly growing team in Huntsville, AL or Colorado Springs, CO. In this role, you will be responsible for bridging systems engineering, applied physics, and mathematical and machine learning to solve complex missile defense problems. You will design track-fusion pipelines, build threat-assignment algorithms, and conduct deep sensitivity analyses across complex architectures. This will require proficiency in applied math, physics, and algorithm development using Python or C++, alongside an understanding of sensor data and battle management workflows. If you are someone who moves quickly, loves diving deep into the math behind the system, and can operate autonomously to deliver verified, defensible technical solutions, then this role is for you.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Machine Learning:** Research, develop, and deploy complex machine learning models such as generative ai, reinforcement learning, deep neural networks, physics based neural models.
* **Algorithm Design and Development:** Formulate and solve complex physics problems using mathematical techniques.
  + Ex: Object detection, tracking, and discrimination. Weapon-Target Assignment (WTA), sensor allocation, and fire control scheduling.
* **Sensor Fusion & Tracking:** Work on the components of system architecture that ingest raw/processed sensor data, execute track fusion, and perform threat classification.
* **Parametric & Sensitivity Analysis:** Design, conduct, and defend rigorous trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and parametric evaluations to determine system boundaries and validate performance.
* **Prototyping & Modeling:** Rapidly translate mathematical equations into clean, functional code (Python / C++) to run non-customer-facing modeling, simulation, and algorithm verification.
* **Mission Systems Architecture:** Bridge the gap between low-level physics/threat intelligence inputs and high-level mission outputs.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
* **Experience:** 5+ years of relevant engineering experience
* Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* **Core Foundation:** Strong mastery of **applied mathematics, physics, and programming**.
* **Algorithmic Programming:** Proficiency in **Python** and/or **C++, Pytorch (or TensorFlow), Coding GPU's,** multi-agent reinforcement learning, mathematical modeling, experience implementing foundation models, and algorithm development (you don't need to be an enterprise software engineer, but you must be able to write robust code to solve math problems).
  + Windows, Linux, MATLAB,
* **Domain Knowledge:** Exposure to missile defense concepts, radar/sensor processing, flight dynamics, TOM, threat intelligence, discrimination algorithms, sensor tracking algorithms, kill assessment, integrated algorithms into operational systems, or fire control systems (GMD, NGI, SM3, Aegis, IBCS, C2BMC, SBI)
  + Military or defense operations experience is a strong plus.
* **Security Clearance:** **Active U.S. Secret clearance required**

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Top Secret / SCI eligible preferred.

new_jobs.title: Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

### **About the Role**

As a Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer, you will own the final mile between embedded code development and physical deployment across our global fleet of connected devices. In this hybrid role, you sit at the intersection of build infrastructure, automated validation, and release governance. You won't just run test suites or push buttons on a deployment train—you will architect the continuous integration pipelines, design Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) automation fixtures, define gatekeeping qualification criteria, and orchestrate safe, staged over-the-air (OTA) updates.

You will work closely with firmware engineers, hardware validation teams, and cloud backend developers to ensure that every build that lands on a customer's wall, ceiling, or door controller is stable, secure, and reliable.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle:** Define, maintain, and optimize the end-to-end release pipeline for embedded Linux and RTOS builds across our devices.
* **Build Automated Validation Systems:** Design, build, and scale automated Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) test harnesses to catch regressions before firmware ever reaches external hardware.
* **Set Quality & Gatekeeping Standards:** Establish clear go/no-go qualification gates, track test flakiness, and lead triage for release-blocking bugs alongside core firmware developers.
* **Orchestrate Safe Deployments:** Drive staged fleet rollouts, canary deployments, and automated telemetry monitoring to catch field anomalies early and execute fast rollbacks when needed.
* **Drive Developer Productivity:** Build tools and CI/CD automation that speed up firmware compile, packaging, and local test cycles.
* **Self-motivated problem solver:** At Verkada, you will tackle large, complex edge-case bugs spanning silicon, firmware, networking, and cloud services with no clear answers.
* **Teach and learn:** You will take technical ownership of major validation systems while collaborating with and mentoring peers across software, firmware, and hardware engineering.

### **What You Bring**

* BS or graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of experience in software/firmware build infrastructure, embedded test automation, or release engineering.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, scripting, and test framework development.
* Working knowledge of C/C++ in embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
* Hands-on experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, TeamCity) for embedded systems.
* Experience with automated test execution on physical hardware targets (HIL testbeds, serial/UART logging, JTAG/SWD, network power switches).
* Understanding of modern version control workflows (Git branching models, tagging, release trains) and build systems (Yocto/BitBake, CMake, Make, Bazel).
* Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week at our San Mateo HQ.
* Must be willing to travel at least one week a year to our engineering office in Krakow, Poland.

### **Nice to Have**

* Working knowledge of Go.
* Experience with secure boot workflows, cryptographic firmware signing, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation.
* Familiarity with over-the-air (OTA) update frameworks and dual-partition (A/B) fallback mechanisms.
* Experience monitoring fleet health telemetry (DataDog, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK).
* Knowledge of standard embedded communication interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet) and Wi-Fi/cellular networking.

### **US Employee Benefits**

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

* Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

new_jobs.title: Senior Flight Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Flight Software Engineer** is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves and operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. The team is responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop reliable flight software that determine how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate throughout the entire mission.
* Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C++.
* Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.
* Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open-ended problems.
* Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V&V) technique.
* Teamwork, communicate and problem solve in a collaborative environment.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
* 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
* Experience with development in C++, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

* End-to-end experience building and launching a spacecraft.
* Experience developing and testing real-time embedded systems.
* Experience with safety-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.
* Experience with CCSDS telemetry and telecommand system.
* Experience with F' or cFS framework.
* Experience with Python, or Rust.
* Knowledge of basic analog and digital electronics.
* Familiarity with SPI, I2C, CAN, EtherCAT.

**Pay Range**
-------------

* Salary range: Senior Software Engineer: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.
* This role is on-sitein El Segundo, CA.
* Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
* You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire "U.S. persons" who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.  
  
"US person" means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

----------------------

Varda Space Industries, Inc. participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

**Description**

  
  

WORK LOCATION: San Luis Obispo, CA

FLSA STATUS: Exempt

SALARY RANGE: The anticipated salary range for this role is $97,000 to $115,000 annually. This range reflects a good faith estimate based on the targeted level for the role and typical compensation benchmarks across U.S. locations. Actual compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, geographical location, and internal alignment.

SUMMARY

The Associate Avionics/Firmware Engineer supports the development, integration, and testing of embedded software and avionics hardware used in UAS platforms. This role focuses on learning and applying fundamentals of embedded programming, sensor integration, electronics troubleshooting, and flight-critical firmware development. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate Engineer contributes to firmware development, board bring-up efforts, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and documentation to ensure reliable and safe operation of aircraft systems.

This is a hands-on position ideal for engineers who enjoy embedded development, debugging hardware, working with microcontrollers, and supporting system integration activities across electrical, software, and mechanical teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The following job functions are a basic requirement but are not limited to and may be assigned other duties.

* Develop and modify embedded firmware for sensors, avionics boards, and microcontroller-based systems under close supervision.

* Support integration and testing of avionics components such as power modules, GPS, radios, flight-control interfaces, and onboard computers.
* Help maintain firmware documentation, configuration management, and version control (Git).
* Participate in bench-level testing, HIL testing, and basic flight-support activities.
