new_jobs.title: Battery and Power Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical-takeoff, long-endurance drones that deliver helicopter-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast.  
  
**The role**  
  
A lead engineer for battery packs and high current distribution in our products. This can include cell selection, architecture, thermal and electrical design, BMS tuning and characterization on the bench. You’ll also play a role in cell and pack vendor relationships, our manufacturing partners, and the safety testing and certification.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Drive pack architecture and future cell evalutions
* Understand and evolve our pack designs including structure, materials, thermal paths, tolerance analysis — and characterize them on the bench.
* Drive BMS hardware architecture, and specify the BMS firmware requirements: what it must do, and how it must fail.
* Own charge control: charger architecture, charge-rate strategy, and the throughput consequences of both.
* Drive battery safety — the analysis, the test campaigns, and the documentation — including UN 38.3 and IEC 62133.
* Lead hardware analysis in support of safety: worst-case circuit analysis, DFMEA, derating, thermal assessment, protection coordination.
* Support Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain through NPI and production ramp.

**What we're looking for**

* Electrical engineering depth with real high-voltage or high-energy battery system experience.
* You've taken a lithium-ion pack from cell selection through to a shipping product.
* BMS electronics experience. Ability to specify architecture options and firmware behavior. History of working with cell monitoring, balancing, protection circuits, isolation measurement.
* Hands-on bench capability: you can instrument a pack, run the thermal characterization, and interpret the data.
* Battery safety test experience
* You anticipate failure systematically — DFMEA, worst-case circuit analysis, derating and stress analysis, thermal margin.
* First-principles thinking and a drive to understand the “why” behind traditional approaches to propulsion, power systems, and even radio technologies.
* This is a hands-on job at a company that is still small. You'll be at the bench, in the shop, on the flight line, and sometimes at a customer site working out why a deployed system is misbehaving — alongside new product development, not instead of it.
* You use AI as a real tool, not a talking point. We want to hear one specific example of something you did with AI that surprised you — a workflow you rebuilt, a problem you came at sideways, an analysis that wouldn't have been worth doing by hand. We care less about which tools you use than about what you've changed about how you work. We're enthusiastic about the leverage and unforgiving about errors.

**Nice to have**

* Both aerospace and automotive high-voltage battery context.
* Charging infrastructure design, and mechanical pack design alongside the electrical side.

**Details**

* Onsite in Santa Clara, CA.
* Compensation range $120-165K

new_jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Thermal and Airflow
new_jobs.description:
Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. We build smart systems and infrastructure for homes, businesses, and municipalities that transform food scraps from landfill-bound waste into valuable resources, including chicken feed. Tens of thousands of Mill's residential food recyclers are already helping households divert millions of pounds of food scraps every year, paving the way for our upcoming launch of Mill Commercial—the industry's first end-to-end solution for managing, understanding, and preventing food waste in commercial environments (e.g. grocery, restaurants, food services). At Mill, we are passionate about building easy-to-use, beautifully designed technologies that keep food in the food system and out of landfills.

**About this Role**

As a Systems Engineer at Mill, you will help characterize, understand, and improve the performance of our next-generation commercial food recycler. This is a hands-on individual contributor role on a small team. You'll work closely with our test engineers to turn experimental data into clear conclusions, review and draft changes to the Engineering Requirements Document (ERD), and take ownership of specific subsystems from characterization through design improvement. You'll collaborate daily with Mechanical, Electrical, Algorithms, and Product. If you enjoy digging into thermal and airflow data and turning it into better hardware, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with the test engineering team to plan experiments and analyze the resulting data on system parameters such as temperatures, airflow, humidity, and heat transfer. Derive conclusions, quantify tradeoffs, and recommend next steps to improve drying performance, energy efficiency, and throughput.
* Own targeted subsystems (e.g. airflow path, condenser, heater, or drying chamber) end to end: define requirements, characterize performance, identify failure modes, and drive design improvements.
* Review proposed changes to the ERD and draft requirement updates based on test results, field data, and cross-functional input, so that requirements stay current and visible to stakeholders.
* Work with the algorithms and firmware teams to provide the data and system understanding needed to refine control schemes for energy use, drying time, and reliable operation.
* Support mechanical engineers in evaluating and iterating on custom hardware such as mixing paddles, air deflectors, and cutting/shredding components, grounded in test data.
* Help define component requirements (fans, blowers, heaters, sensors, flow meters) and support part selection and evaluation.
* Build reusable analysis tools and clear reports (plots, summaries, test writeups) that make results legible across the team.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of hands-on engineering experience with a thermal, airflow/fluids, or mechanical systems focus. Experience with thermal testing and airflow characterization is strongly preferred; a mechanical design background with strong test and analysis skills is also a great fit.
* Comfortable analyzing time-series test data and communicating findings clearly. Python is preferred, but other tools (R, MATLAB, spreadsheets, AI-assisted analysis) are acceptable.
* Experience writing or reviewing engineering requirements, test plans, or similar technical documentation.
* Familiarity with electromechanical components such as fans, blowers, heaters, valves, and sensors.
* BS in Mechanical, Thermal, Process, Chemical, or a related engineering field.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to present results to engineers across disciplines.
* Able to work independently on an owned area while collaborating closely with a small, fast-moving team.

**Nice to have**

* + Prior experience taking a product or process from prototype toward production.
  + Exposure to CFD or thermal simulation results and how to validate them against test data.
  + Startup or small-team experience with fast paced environments

**What we are looking for**

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

**In this role you will**

* Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
* Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
* Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
* Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
* Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
* Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

* Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
* Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
* Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
* Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
* Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

**Desirable qualifications**

* ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
* Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
* Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
* Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
* Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.

### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations | Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA**

### **About the Role**

The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.

### **Responsibilities**

Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:

* Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.
* Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.
* Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.
* Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.
* The team is geographically distributed across North America.
* You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.

### **Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience**

* You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You understand how to write code that respects CPU and memory constraints.
* You are comfortable with the Linux networking stack. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets.
* You don't just use databases; you understand how they work. You're familiar with connection lifecycles, transaction states, and wire protocols.
* You enjoy the challenge of debugging complex, distributed systems and building for "five nines" reliability.

### **Bonus Points**

* Experience with PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or custom database middleware.
* Familiarity with the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem and the unique stateful connection challenges of ephemeral computing.
* You've contributed to database drivers, ORMs, or low-level networking libraries.
* Experience using eBPF, perf, or other profiling tools to find and kill bottlenecks.

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

* For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000
* For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

new_jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Manager - Mixed Signal Hardware
new_jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

#### **Electrical Engineering Manager - Mixed Signal Hardware**

As an Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for the delivery of our custom Software Defined Radios. As a team leader you will oversee cradle to grave hardware development: architecture definition, board design, testing, and qualification.

#### **Ideal Candidate**

* An individual who has built and overseen the entire design cycle of FPGA based software defined radios for GEO space telecommunications satellites
* Proven record of delivering custom designed hardware that spans the entire range of signal chain design, integration of FPGAs with high speed data converters, custom power and clocking solutions, and supporting RTL development
* Experience with design and analysis of payloads for satellite communications, including radiation effects within FPGA based systems or highly complex digital devices
* History of leading small teams and mentoring employees, strong communication skills, and ability to make high impact decisions under uncertainty.

#### **Role**

* Lead and develop a team of electrical engineers to design industry shattering software defined radios capable of running complex signal processing algorithms in space!
* Oversee and manage design workflows for highly complex PCBAs with integrated compute, high speed I/O, data converters, and power distribution.
* Architect ultra high-speed mixed signal systems to achieve the most efficient and flexible communications payloads, integrating them with the rest of the spacecraft
* Ensure competitiveness through continuous technical innovation and industry expertise

#### **Requirements**

* B.S. or higher in electrical or computer engineering, or similar technical degree
* 8+ years of professional experience in mixed-signal and high-speed digital hardware design. Examples include FPGAs, high speed data converters, SerDes and high speed serial links, networking, JESD204C
* 8+ years of PCB-level experience designing hardware from concept through production (schematic capture, layout, bring-up, characterization, etc)
* Proven leadership through project management, mentorship, and people management experience
* A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design

#### **Bonus**

* Strong background in mixed signal system performance measurement, design validation, and debugging (EVM testing, spur analysis, multi-carrier measurements, etc)
* Experience simulating high speed digital protocols using Ansys SIwave, Keysight ADS, or similar tools
* Experience with Altium or similar EDA tools for high-density PCB design
* Strong background in digital communications theory and measurement of radio nonidealities (HD, IMD, IQ imbalance, gain ripple, group delay distortion, etc)

**U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required**

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

As an Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for the delivery of our custom Software Defined Radios. As a team leader you will oversee cradle to grave hardware development: architecture definition, board design, testing, and qualification.

#### **Ideal Candidate:**

* An individual who has built and overseen the entire design cycle of FPGA based software defined radios for GEO space telecommunications satellites
* Proven record of delivering custom designed hardware that spans the entire range of signal chain design, integration of FPGAs with high speed data converters, custom power and clocking solutions, and supporting RTL development
* Experience with design and analysis of payloads for satellite communications, including radiation effects within FPGA based systems or highly complex digital devices
* History of leading small teams and mentoring employees, strong communication skills, and ability to make high impact decisions under uncertainty

#### **Role:**

* Lead and develop a team of electrical engineers to design industry shattering software defined radios capable of running complex signal processing algorithms in space!
* Oversee and manage design workflows for highly complex PCBAs with integrated compute, high speed I/O, data converters, and power distribution.
* Architect ultra high-speed mixed signal systems to achieve the most efficient and flexible communications payloads, integrating them with the rest of the spacecraft
* Ensure competitiveness through continuous technical innovation and industry expertise

#### **Requirements:**

* B.S. or higher in electrical or computer engineering, or similar technical degree
* 8+ years of professional experience in mixed-signal and high-speed digital hardware design. Examples include FPGAs, high speed data converters, SerDes and high speed serial links, networking, JESD204C
* 8+ years of PCB-level experience designing hardware from concept through production (schematic capture, layout, bring-up, characterization, etc)
* Proven leadership through project management, mentorship, and people management experience
* A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design

#### **Bonus:**

* Strong background in mixed signal system performance measurement, design validation, and debugging (EVM testing, spur analysis, multi-carrier measurements, etc)
* Experience simulating high speed digital protocols using Ansys SIwave, Keysight ADS, or similar tools
* Experience with Altium or similar EDA tools for high-density PCB design
* Strong background in digital communications theory and measurement of radio nonidealities (HD, IMD, IQ imbalance, gain ripple, group delay distortion, etc)

**U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required**

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

#### **Astranis SMS Terms of Service**

* **Recruiting Updates:** By opting in, you agree to receive SMS updates, interview coordination, and recruiting communications from Astranis Space Technologies Corp.

* **Opt-Out:** You can cancel this service at any time by replying **STOP**. We will send one final text confirming your unsubscription.

* **Opt-In Again:** To resume receiving messages, reply **START** or **YES**.

* **Support & Rates:** For assistance, reply **HELP** or contact us at coordinators@astranis.com. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies; carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

* **Privacy:** For details on how we protect your data, view our Privacy Policy.

To design, engineer and implement Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) systems associated with building, cooling, electrical, vacuum and safety systems.

* Production, installation and commissioning of PLC systems
* Integrated commissioning of the PLC systems
* Documentation, operation and enhancement of PLC systems

* Design of Human Machine Interfaces (HMI)

Required: B.S. Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Computer Science

Preferred: Allen-Bradley Course Certification

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer-Mission Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:

GBL is based in Camarillo, CA.

  

GBL Systems is seeking a Mission Data Analyst to support data collection, analysis, visualization, mission assessment, and data-driven debrief activities supporting Department of War (DoW) test and experimentation activities. The successful candidate will aggregate, correlate, analyze, and visualize data from instrumentation, sensors, mission platforms, operational networks, and distributed test environments to produce operationally relevant insights.

  

**U.S. citizenship and current active SECRET clearance required.**

  

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Collect, process, validate, correlate, and analyze mission, test, instrumentation, and operational data from multiple sources.
* Develop dashboards, visualizations, reports, and analytical products supporting test execution and mission assessment.
* Analyze data from sensors, telemetry, mission platforms, communications systems, and operational networks.
* Support mission replay, event reconstruction, data-driven debrief, and post-event analysis.
* Develop data processing workflows, analytical methodologies, metrics, and performance measures.
* Identify trends, anomalies, operational observations, and performance insights.
* Support development of assessment products, test reports, executive summaries, and customer deliverables.
* Perform data validation, quality assurance, and analytical troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with engineers, operators, test personnel, and Government stakeholders to define analytical requirements.
* Support field events, demonstrations, experimentation, and test execution as required.

  

**Job Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent relevant technical or military experience may substitute.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, mission analysis, operational assessment, T&E, intelligence analysis, or related analytical activities.
* Experience working with large, complex datasets and multiple data sources.
* Experience developing dashboards, visualizations, reports, and analytical products.
* Proficiency with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
* Experience with data validation, quality assessment, and analytical troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to travel and support operational/test events as required.
* **Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance upon hire is required..**

  

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Outstanding 401(k) retirement plan with both Traditional and Roth options and generous corporate contributing
* Group medical insurance
* Dental/Vision Insurance
* Life insurance
* AD&D coverage
* Paid holiday and Paid Time Off
* Business casual work environment

  

GBL is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

  

Salary Range: $129,089 USD to $185,000 USD. Salary is based on current qualifications, related experience, and contractual requirements which could fall outside of this range.

Signia designs, manufactures, and services a wide range of products, that include mission equipment, thermal management systems, engine technology, and propellers. The Signia brands are leaders in their respective markets and provide a compelling value proposition to both aerospace and defense OEMs and end-users.

Onboard Systems Hoist & Winch, located in Anaheim, CA is one of the world’s leading providers of Search & Rescue (SAR) and Human External Cargo (HEC) advanced mission equipment for civil, commercial, and military helicopters.

**Position Overview**

**Location:** Anaheim, CA (Onsite)

**Schedule:** Monday - Friday

**Pay:** $72,000 - $76,000 per year

The Electrical Engineering Technician supports the design, development, testing, installation, and maintenance of electrical and electronic systems. This role works closely with electrical engineers to build prototypes, fabricate test equipment and wiring harnesses, perform testing and troubleshooting, document results, and assist in bringing products and systems from concept to production.

**What You’ll Do**

* Assist electrical engineers in the design, development, and implementation of electrical systems and equipment.
* Build, assemble, modify, and maintain electrical test boxes, test fixtures, control panels, cable assemblies, and wiring harnesses to support engineering development, validation, and production testing.
* Fabricate and install prototype wiring harnesses and cable assemblies in accordance with engineering drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and workmanship standards.
* Conduct electrical testing, data collection, and performance evaluations.
* Troubleshoot electrical circuits, wiring harnesses, control systems, and electronic components.
* Support product validation and verification activities.
* Support manufacturing and production teams with technical problem-solving.

**Who You Are**

**Required Qualifications**

* Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience in an electrical technician or engineering support role preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, cable drawings, and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of electrical circuits, electronic components, and control systems.
* Hands-on experience fabricating, terminating, routing, and troubleshooting electrical wiring harnesses and cable assemblies.
* Ability to build and wire test boxes, control panels, and test fixtures from electrical schematics and engineering drawings.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Ability to fabricate, assemble, and verify wiring harnesses, cable assemblies, and electrical test equipment from engineering documentation.
* Proficiency in soldering, crimping, connector assembly, wire labeling, and cable management techniques.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to workmanship quality.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Hands-on technical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.

**What’s In It for You**

* Benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability
* Paid time off and holidays
* 401(k) plan with employer contribution matching
* In addition to offering competitive wages and benefits, Onboard Systems also offers the opportunity to increase your future earnings tied to growth in company performance. We recognize employee contributions toward growing the business through our unique Growth Participation Unit program (GPU). GPUs are tied directly to company growth and reward all eligible employees with cash when the business grows over time.

Hydraulic Controls, Inc. is a 100% employee-owned premier fluid power distributor serving customers throughout the Western United States. For more than 60 years, our employee-owners and supplier partners have built our reputation on ethical business practices, value-added customer service, technical expertise, and local inventory.

We are a practical, relationship-driven company with a strong operational focus. Our branches support customers who rely on responsive service, dependable products, and people who know how to solve problems.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer who can design practical, reliable low-voltage DC control systems for mobile equipment. This role is a strong fit for someone with a background in mobile equipment controls, mechatronics, electro-mechanical systems, or similar hands-on electrical engineering applications.

* **Mobile Equipment Controls Expertise** – Brings experience designing, troubleshooting, and improving low-voltage DC electrical control systems used in real-world equipment applications.
* **Practical Design Judgment** – Understands how to balance customer requirements, component selection, manufacturability, reliability, cost, and serviceability.
* **Testing and Troubleshooting Discipline** – Is comfortable using diagnostic tools, validating system performance, identifying issues, and confirming that finished products meet quality and functional expectations.
* **Hands-On Engineering Mindset** – Is willing and able to support prototype installation, field testing, diagnostics, and equipment-level problem solving in practical shop or field environments.

**Position Summary**

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for designing low-voltage DC electrical control systems for mobile equipment, including schematics, component selection, prototype support, testing, troubleshooting, and production documentation. This role supports the development of practical, reliable mobile machine control solutions and works closely with internal teams to ensure designs meet customer requirements, quality expectations, and production needs.

This position is well suited for an engineer with experience in mobile equipment controls, mechatronics, electro-mechanical systems, or similar hands-on electrical engineering applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Evaluates electrical systems, products, components, and applications by designing and conducting research programs; applying knowledge of electricity and materials.
* Develops electrical products by studying customer requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials.
* Assures product quality by designing electrical testing methods; testing finished products and system capabilities.
* Prepares product reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
* Provides engineering information by answering questions and requests.
* Maintains product and company reputation by complying with federal and state regulations.
* Assists in maintaining the approved Item and Vendor lists, ensuring both are kept accurate and up-to-date.
* Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; participating in professional societies.
* Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
* Help promote the use of HCI and MCDS products in mobile equipment.
* Assist with installation and testing of prototype control systems including using hand tools, using testing and diagnostic tools, climbing on equipment, crawling under equipment.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

* A.S. Degree in related field with five years practical experience designing low voltage DC control systems, Bachelors Degree strongly preferred.
* Ability to produce quality CAD drawings.
* Electronic Systems, Electronics Troubleshooting, Electronic Testing Design, Project Management, Quality Focus, Database Design, Analyzing Information, Reporting Research Results, Attention to Detail, Emphasizing Excellence, Innovation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, and Adobe Acrobat.
* Proficiency with electrical diagnostic devices such as DMM, oscilloscope, and frequency generator.

Work Location

**About E.I. Medical Imaging**

E.I. Medical Imaging (EIMI) designs and manufactures the Ibex family of portable, ruggedized ultrasound systems for veterinary use, built for chutes, barns, and pastures around the globe. We are a small, hands-on team where engineers own their work from first schematic through production and field support.

**The Role**

EIMI is looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to own the design of the PCBs used in its systems: architecture, component selection, schematic capture, multilayer layout, bring-up, and release to manufacturing, for current Ibex products and our next-generation platform.

This position is the primary electrical design authority on PCBs, working closely with firmware, software, mechanical, production, and service to deliver hardware that is compact, power-efficient, manufacturable, and tough enough for years of field use.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own board architecture, schematic capture, and multilayer PCB layout for new products and revisions, including library and footprint management.
* Design mixed-signal circuits spanning high-speed digital (processors/SoCs, DDR, USB, PCIe, MIPI), low-noise analog including ultrasound AFE, and power electronics.
* Design battery-powered systems: Li-ion charging and protection, DC-DC conversion, power sequencing, and low-power modes.
* Apply sound SI/PI, grounding, impedance control, and stackup practices, and design for shock, vibration, moisture, temperature, and ESD in harsh field environments.
* Select components for performance, cost, availability, and lifecycle; manage second sources, obsolescence, and accurate BOMs with purchasing.
* Lead prototype bring-up, debug, and design verification, including EMC/EMI, RED/FCC, and electrical safety compliance testing.
* Release complete fabrication and assembly packages using DFM, DFA, and DFT principles, working directly with fab houses and contract manufacturers.
* Support production and service with root-cause analysis on failed boards and field returns, and maintain design documentation and ECOs.

**Required Qualifications**

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 5+ years of board-level hardware design experience, taking multiple products from concept to production.
* Proven ability to independently own both schematic capture and multilayer layout in Altium Designer, OrCAD/Allegro, KiCad, or similar.
* Working knowledge of processor-based designs (ARM SoCs or similar), DDR memory, and high-speed serial interfaces.
* Experience with mixed-signal, power-management, and battery-powered design, including signal/power integrity and stackup fundamentals.
* Hands-on bench skills: bring-up, debug, and fine-pitch SMT/BGA rework.
* Familiarity with EMC/EMI design practices and compliance testing.
* Clear documentation habits and the ability to explain design tradeoffs to non-EE teammates.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ultrasound, imaging, or other high-channel-count analog/data acquisition systems.
* Experience integrating edge AI/ML compute modules into embedded hardware.
* Experience with portable or ruggedized products, and with Wi-Fi/Bluetooth RF layout and antenna integration.
* Familiarity with CE (including RED), FCC, IEC 61010/60601, and quality systems such as ISO 13485 or ISO 9001.
* Experience with FPGA hardware design.
* Experience building a PCB design process, libraries, and design reviews at a small company.

* **First year:** Take at least one board through prototype into production and become the go-to resource for board issues.

You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry's AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero-latency DFM feedback and one-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment.

This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location.

**How You'll Contribute**
-------------------------

* **Software Development and Technical Craft:** You will design high-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs.
* **AI Fluency:** You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real-time geometry analysis. In addition, you'll champion AI-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil.

You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry's engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure.

* **Collaboration and Communication:** You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well-documented decisions. * **Operational Excellence:** You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise-grade deployments, whether partner-hosted or Xometry-hosted, ensuring seamless multi-tenant management.

**What You'll Bring to Xometry**

For over three decades, Alpha Data has empowered leading aerospace, defence, and datacenter customers with RF/analog, and high speed digital compute solutions based around AMD FPGAs. From our locations in the USA and UK, we bring the inherent cost savings and accelerated time-to-market of commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) products to customers around the world. Our highly skilled design team also specializes in modified COTS solutions to meet our customer’s unique and challenging requirements, ensuring we succeed together!

**The Role**

We are seeking a senior engineer to design high-performance embedded products combining RF/microwave, analog, and high-speed digital circuitry, based around AMD Versal RF and adaptive SoC platforms. The role is hands-on, spans the full product lifecycle, and requires a broad skillset. This includes expertise in RF/analog design (e.g. impedance matching, simulation, and lab validation) combined with experience in high-speed digital PCB design (e.g. DDR5, 200G ethernet, and PCIe Gen6) and the ability to merge these varied disciplines into a dense multilayer PCB while accounting for the associated power and signal integrity challenges.

In addition to electronics design, the role involves: hardware bring-up, characterisation, FPGA design, creating software for validation, supporting production, and customer communications.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop mixed-signal PCBs combining RF/analog (to ~18 GHz) with high-speed digital interfaces (e.g. DDR5, SERDES) around AMD FPGA platforms.
* Perform RF design and simulation (e.g. matching networks, transmission lines, baluns) and validate designs using simulation and lab equipment (3D EM simulation, VNA, spectrum analyser, signal generator).
* Take ownership of board-level design from schematic through layout support, bring-up, and characterisation.
* Work closely with PCB layout engineers on high-density, multilayer designs with tight signal and power integrity requirements.
* Debug and diagnose hardware issues at board and system level, including RF performance, high-speed interfaces, and power-related problems.

* Collaborate with firmware, software, and mechanical teams to deliver complete, systems.
* Support production and customer-facing activities, including issue investigation and technical documentation.

* 8+ years of experience in board-level hardware design with a strong focus on analog/RF.

* Demonstrated experience with analog RF and high-speed digital design principles, including signal integrity and power integrity considerations.

* Excellent problem-solving skills and a meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in analog and digital hardware design.
* Strong understanding of Direct RF FPGA architectures, development flows, and design techniques (VHDL/Verilog).

new_jobs.title: HPC Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**The future of aerospace and defense starts here.**

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

  

**The journey to space starts with the engines.**

Ursa Major is bringing a new model to propulsion and defense technology: one where performance and access are no longer constrained by legacy systems. We design, build, and deploy advanced propulsion systems that power national security missions, hypersonic capabilities, and the future of space access.

Our mission requires an extraordinary team; one that will mold tomorrow's critical technologies while deploying today's best. We are an intrinsically motivated team with a passion for solving complex technical problems and empowering each other every day, knowing that there is always room for growth.

**About The Role**

As a critical member of our Digital Operations team reporting to the IT Manager, the HPC Systems Engineer holds a dual mandate: driving the continuous expansion of our High-Performance Computing (HPC) simulation clusters while serving as IT's core Enterprise Linux Subject Matter Expert.

By taking ownership of our HPC infrastructure, you will directly liberate engineering bandwidth and accelerate propulsion design cycles enabling our solids, liquids, thermal, and structural analysis teams to run complex CFD/FEA workloads faster and at greater scale. Simultaneously, you will partner with IT, DevOps, and Zero-Trust Networking to architect, automate, and harden our enterprise Linux servers across our Colorado and Ohio facilities.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, deploy, expand, and optimize Linux-based HPC clusters, storage systems, and compute nodes supporting mission-critical propulsion analysis.
* Administer job schedulers and resource managers (e.g., Slurm, PBS) to ensure fair-share scheduling, efficient queue utilization, and minimal job latency for engineering users.
* Partner directly with solids, liquids, thermal, and CFD analysis engineers to integrate, benchmark, and optimize commercial and open-source simulation suites (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus) and GPU-accelerated workloads (NVIDIA CUDA).
* Manage high-throughput storage solutions (e.g., BeeGFS, NVMe-oF, NFS) and high-speed network fabrics (InfiniBand / 100GbE) to eliminate data bottlenecks during large-scale parallel processing.
* Act as the primary systems engineer and Level 2/3 escalation point for enterprise Linux systems, hypervisors, and core IT infrastructure.
* Automate system provisioning, configuration management, patching, and user onboarding using Ansible, Python, Bash, Terraform, and automated kickstart routines.
* Integrate Linux servers and HPC head nodes with enterprise identity platforms (Entra ID, SSSD) for centralized authentication and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Implement and maintain system hardening, access controls, patching, and vulnerability management aligned with NIST SP 800-171, CMMC Level 2, and ITAR/CUI data protection requirements.
* Deploy metrics, alerting, and telemetry frameworks (e.g., PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana) to proactively monitor node health, cluster temperature, memory usage, and hardware failures.
* Maintain clean architectural diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and system security plans (SSPs) for all Linux and HPC environments.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of dedicated experience in Linux systems engineering and infrastructure administration.
* Hands-on mastery of enterprise Linux distributions (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu Server) including kernel tuning, storage management (LVM, ZFS), and network configuration.
* Demonstrated experience building, managing, or scaling HPC clusters, job schedulers (Slurm, PBS), and distributed MPI/GPU environments.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Bash, and Ansible or Terraform for infrastructure automation.
* Practical understanding of system hardening, vulnerability patching, and security controls in CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, DoD, or similar regulated compliance frameworks.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity supporting engineering simulation platforms (ANSYS Fluent/Mechanical, Siemens STAR-CCM+, Abaqus, or MATLAB).
* Experience configuring InfiniBand/RoCE fabrics, high-performance parallel file systems, and NVIDIA GPU clusters.
* Experience with enterprise hypervisor clusters (e.g. VMware vSphere).
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance.

**Compensation, Location & Classification**

* Primary Location: Hybrid (Longmont, CO office)
* On-Site Presence: Periodic support at our Berthoud, CO facility and data center colocation in the Denver Tech Center (DTC).
* Remote Support: Ongoing support for Ohio facilities.

  

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $108,000 - $135,000, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we *can't* quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

The candidate will support sustainment activities for a diverse portfolio of strategic and tactical MILSATCOM space systems and infrastructure. The candidate will provide systems engineering and integration expertise in support of legacy space constellations including, but not limited to, Milstar, Advanced Enhanced High Frequency (AEHF) and Enhanced Polar System (EPS) and associated ground infrastructure, warfighter terminals and software applications such as Family of Beyond Line‐of‐Sight Terminal (FAB‐T), Global Aircrew Strategic Network Terminal (Global‐ASNT), Milstar Messaging System (MMS), Global Broadcast Service (GBS) and Ground Multiband Terminal (GMT) along with various other systems, subsystems and devices in a multidisciplinary environment. The candidate will also have a direct impact on new MILSATCOM space systems transitioning from the acquisition community to operational stakeholders.

This opportunity is an engineering management position. We seek a self‐starter who is capable of autonomous, on‐the‐job learning/growth. We seek technical individuals who will thrive by working in a collaborative work environment of small teams tackling the challenges of sustaining complex, space‐based, telecommunication systems. The candidate will have a positive, tangible effect across all aspects of the space system (spacecraft, uplinks/downlinks, command & control, networks, users) while improving overall combat readiness.

We support the Air Force's acquisition of state-of-the-art Military Satellite Communications systems, providing global secure, survivable, and protected communications for our nation's warfighters. We seek technical individuals who will thrive in a highly collaborative work environment of small teams, using the most modern tools and methodologies to tackle the challenges of integrating complex space and ground communications systems.

* Evaluates and produces products of a technical nature using technical rigor, adequacy, completeness, and appropriate application of the specialty engineering disciplines as standard process

* 4+ years of experience working in a highly competitive multi‐contractor environment

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Space Ground Systems Engineering team solves the mathematical, physical, and algorithmic problems at the core of next-generation missile defense and fire control systems. We tackle dynamic battle-management challenges: fusing real-time sensor streams into track data, optimizing weapon-target assignment under uncertainty, and feeding high-confidence fire-control schedules back to the warfighter.

#### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Systems Engineer - Machine Learning to join our rapidly growing team in Huntsville, AL or Colorado Springs, CO. In this role, you will be responsible for bridging systems engineering, applied physics, and mathematical and machine learning to solve complex missile defense problems. You will design track-fusion pipelines, build threat-assignment algorithms, and conduct deep sensitivity analyses across complex architectures. This will require proficiency in applied math, physics, and algorithm development using Python or C++, alongside an understanding of sensor data and battle management workflows. If you are someone who moves quickly, loves diving deep into the math behind the system, and can operate autonomously to deliver verified, defensible technical solutions, then this role is for you.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Machine Learning:** Research, develop, and deploy complex machine learning models such as generative ai, reinforcement learning, deep neural networks, physics based neural models.
* **Algorithm Design and Development:** Formulate and solve complex physics problems using mathematical techniques.
  + Ex: Object detection, tracking, and discrimination. Weapon-Target Assignment (WTA), sensor allocation, and fire control scheduling.

* **Parametric & Sensitivity Analysis:** Design, conduct, and defend rigorous trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and parametric evaluations to determine system boundaries and validate performance.
* **Prototyping & Modeling:** Rapidly translate mathematical equations into clean, functional code (Python / C++) to run non-customer-facing modeling, simulation, and algorithm verification.
* **Mission Systems Architecture:** Bridge the gap between low-level physics/threat intelligence inputs and high-level mission outputs.

* Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
* **Experience:** 5+ years of relevant engineering experience
* Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* **Core Foundation:** Strong mastery of **applied mathematics, physics, and programming**.

* **Domain Knowledge:** Exposure to missile defense concepts, radar/sensor processing, flight dynamics, TOM, threat intelligence, discrimination algorithms, sensor tracking algorithms, kill assessment, integrated algorithms into operational systems, or fire control systems (GMD, NGI, SM3, Aegis, IBCS, C2BMC, SBI)
  + Military or defense operations experience is a strong plus.
* **Security Clearance:** **Active U.S. Secret clearance required**

* Top Secret / SCI eligible preferred.

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Faex Health**

Faex Health turns stool images into gut-health insights. Our platform combines proprietary computer-vision models, color-density analysis, and Felix, our retrieval-grounded AI assistant, to help people track changes over time and to support clinicians and researchers. Faex runs on iPhone and Android in 13 languages across multiple regions. Live features include Faex MD for clinicians, women’s health with a period tracker, a GLP-1 gut-health journey, and partner APIs connecting to care and research ecosystems.

**The Role**

We are hiring a QA automation engineer to expand and formalize our existing test suite and CI. Today we run a Django test suite and browser regression tests, and an Azure DevOps pipeline runs tests and a secret scan on every pull request to our main and release branches. You will strengthen the frameworks, extend coverage across the web app, APIs, mobile apps, and image-analysis pipeline, and make test results part of every release decision. You will work directly with our CTO and developers.

**What You Will Do**

* **Test frameworks.** Expand and formalize our automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing, building on the existing Django test suite, with clear structure, reusable components, and reporting.
* **Azure Pipelines integration.** Extend the Azure Pipelines YAML checks that already run tests and a secret scan on every pull request, publish results, and add quality gates that block failing builds.
* **Azure DevOps test management.** Organize test plans, suites, and cases, using Azure Test Plans where it adds value; log and track defects in Azure Boards linked to stories and builds; keep tests in Azure Repos.
* **Web UI automation.** Expand browser regression tests for the Django web app using tools such as Playwright or Selenium, covering our new Bootstrap 5 interface.
* **API testing.** Test REST and partner APIs, including FHIR-based integrations, authentication, and error handling.
* **Mobile testing.** Test the iPhone and Android apps that wrap our web app, covering photo upload, deep links, sign-in flows, and device differences, using tools such as Appium and cloud device testing.
* **Image-analysis pipeline testing.** Build regression checks that run labeled reference images through new model releases to confirm detection, color-density, and scoring results stay within agreed limits.
* **Release verification.** Run and extend smoke tests after Elastic Beanstalk deployments, building on the /health/ check in our deploy pipeline, and help decide whether to proceed or roll back.
* **Performance testing.** Create load and performance tests for scan processing, queues, and peak traffic, using tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter.
* **Test data and compliance.** Build safe test data using synthetic or de-identified records, never real patient information, and support SOC 2 and HIPAA audit evidence.
* **Quality metrics.** Track coverage, flaky tests, and defect trends, and work with developers to improve testability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in software quality assurance, including 3+ years building test automation.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining an automation framework, not just writing scripts within one.
* Experience running and maintaining automated tests in CI/CD pipelines, triggered on pull requests and releases.
* Strong Python testing skills (Django test framework / unittest; pytest also valuable); experience testing Django or other Python web apps.
* Experience with browser automation using Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Experience with API testing tools and frameworks, such as Django’s test client, Python HTTP clients, or Postman.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD, Git branching, and test strategies such as unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression.
* Clear defect reporting and communication with developers.
* Comfortable working day to day with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Kiro) and quick to pick up new tools as they change.
* Ability to work in the Denver office three days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the Faex app or experience testing health, wellness, or medical software.
* Experience with Azure DevOps: Azure Pipelines YAML, Azure Test Plans, Azure Boards, and Azure Repos.
* Experience with mobile automation using Appium or cloud device testing services.
* Experience testing machine-learning or computer-vision outputs.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter.
* Experience testing on AWS, including Elastic Beanstalk deployments and environment management.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and validating data in tests.
* Experience working under HIPAA, SOC 2, or FDA software quality requirements.
* ISTQB or a similar testing certification.

**How We Work**

* Small team, high ownership: you will set our testing standards, not just follow them.
* Evidence-led: every release decision should be backed by test results.
* Privacy by default: test data must never expose real health information.

Pay: $70,700.00 - $85,300.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greenwood Vlg, CO 80111

**Controls Hardware Engineer (Electrical & Motion Focus)**  
***Suwanee, GA***  
  
**ABOUT US**  
Located across the globe and with more than 45 years of experience, WSI is the industry leader in automated repairs for pressure equipment. WSI's industry experience, global presence, and best-in-class execution are key to delivering improved plant reliability safely and effectively.  
  
WSI has the mission to advance innovation for global infrastructure through specialized industrial technologies. At WSI, our people empower and define who we are. Our shared values are the foundation for building strong, trusting relationships with our employees, stakeholders, and customers. We're small enough for your ideas to make an immediate impact and large enough to offer you opportunities to grow professionally at any stage of your career.  
  
**JOB SUMMARY**  
We are seeking a skilled **Controls Hardware Engineer** to lead the physical design, schematic creation, and prototype assembly of our next-generation motion control systems. In this role, you will be the bridge between electronic component selection and physical execution. Your primary focus will be designing robust control circuits, mapping out industrial wiring architectures, and specifying hardware for PLC-based motion systems.  
  
This is a hardware-focused engineering role. While you will collaborate closely with our software engineering team, your principal responsibility will be the physical infrastructure: creating electrical drawings, designing panel layouts, and executing hands-on prototype builds.  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design and specify low-voltage DC control circuits, power distributions, and physical wiring topologies for multi-axis motion control systems independently suggesting solutions and identifying the information or resources needed to move the work forward.
* Create comprehensive, production-ready electrical schematics, point-to-point wiring diagrams, and control panel layouts using industrial CAD tools (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN).
* Lead the physical build, wiring, and hardware troubleshooting of initial prototype systems and test benches.
* Evaluate and select microprocessors, industrial controllers, sensors, motor drives, and safety interlocks required for high-performance motion applications researching and becoming proficient with new technologies as needed.
* Participate in and actively contribute to tooling design teams
* Work effectively with a high level of autonomy while maintaining strong communication and collaboration across multiple departments.
* Progress multiple projects and tasks based on schedule and budget commitments proactively identifying priorities, resolving obstacles, and escalating issues when appropriate.
* Contribute to plotting short- and long-term technology strategies for the business to support potential growth areas and technology differentiation
* Provide support as required to resolve technology deficiencies in the existing technology base including researching unfamiliar issues and developing solutions with limited direction.
* Provide technical mentoring to less experienced engineering personnel.
* Resolve complex and unique technical issues and provide expert technical reviews and troubleshooting.
* Other duties as assigned.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCES**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related field
* 5+ years of experience in electrical design, industrial control panel design, or physical hardware engineering for automation/motion systems.
* Mastery of industrial electrical schematic software (AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, or similar).
* Deep understanding of circuit protection, industrial wiring standards, microprocessors, and sensor integration.
* Working knowledge of and adherence to applicable NEC, NFPA, and CSA standards, as well as applicable CE conformity requirements.
* Proven experience with hands-on mechanical/electrical assembly, wire crimping, soldering, and troubleshooting physical hardware with multimeters/oscilloscopes.
* Working knowledge of robotics and arc welding and machining processes is a plus
* Experience in computer-aided tools used to design electrical control systems
* Experience in design for high noise environment, a plus
* Support field personnel in troubleshooting problems with existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **PLC Hardware Familiarity**: Experience specifying and wiring components within B&R Industrial Automation ecosystems (X20 system, ACOPOS drives, etc.) is highly preferred.
* **Cobots:** Familiarity with collaborative robot integration, safety zones, and end-of-arm tooling hardware.
* **PCB: (**printed circuit board) design and layout experience.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

**Who We Are**
--------------

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer who can design and build best-in-class planning systems for autonomous driving in structured, low-speed environments.

In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of the planning stack — owning the design and implementation of production-grade mission planning, behavior planning, and motion planning software. You'll work across the full planning pipeline to achieve category-defining vehicle autonomy for the airside, tackling hard problems in trajectory optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, and real-time constraint optimization.

This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model. This role reports to our Planning Tech Lead and works closely with the autonomy engineering team.

You Will:

* Design, implement, and iterate on the mission planner, behavior planner, and motion planner for autonomous ground support equipment operating in airport airside environments.
* Drive key technical decisions across the planning stack — selecting algorithms, defining interfaces, and establishing the architecture that the team builds on.
* Prototype and evaluate new planning approaches (e.g., optimization-based methods, search-based planners, learning-augmented pipelines) and bring the best ideas to production.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with perception, controls, localization, and systems engineering teams to deliver an integrated autonomous driving system.
* Establish and promote best practices in software development, functional safety, and systems engineering as they apply to the planning domain.
* Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, code review, and design discussions.

You Have:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Math, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field.
* Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing planning modules for autonomous systems shipped to production or deployed in real-world operations.
* Strong programming skills in C++ (preferred) or Python, and experience with Linux-based operating systems.
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous technical problems and drive them to well-architected solutions independently.
* Excellent communication skills, proactiveness, and a strong sense of ownership.

We Prefer:

* MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
* Mastery of Modern C++ (14 and beyond) and safety-critical coding practices (e.g., MISRA, ISO 26262).
* 5+ years of industry experience in planning for robotic ground vehicles.
* In-depth understanding of DDS frameworks like ROS/ROS2 or other networking middleware.
* Experience in startup environments, demonstrating adaptability to rapidly changing priorities.

We are a US based company headquartered in Woodridge, Illinois and have a global presence that extends across four continents with five manufacturing facilities, three engineering technical centers, a multi-tiered sales service channel, and 3,000+ employees. For over 60 years, Inventus Power has been addressing the rapidly expanding power demands of a changing world through technology and engineered solutions. We continue to invest in our people and processes, while enhancing our products and capabilities in order to create a safer, smarter, and more sustainable battery-powered world.*

We are an ITAR facility and hire only U.S. persons who are defined as U.S. citizens or green card holders.

**What You’ll Do**

The Controls Software Engineer II will contribute to the development, integration, validation, and support of Battery Management System (BMS) software for xEV and advanced battery applications. This role will support requirements definition, controls algorithm development, software implementation, calibration, testing, and system integration activities while collaborating with hardware, systems, validation, and customer engineering teams

**Responsibilities (Including other duties as assigned)**

* Participate in requirements definition, software design, implementation, and testing activities for Battery Management System (BMS) software and controls functions.
* Develop, implement, and maintain battery control algorithms and features including State of Charge (SOC), State of Health (SOH), State of Power (SOP), charging control, fault detection, diagnostics, balancing, and battery safety functions.
* Support calibration, tuning, and optimization of battery algorithms to meet product performance, reliability, and safety requirements.
* Collaborate with systems, hardware, and validation engineers to ensure successful integration of BMS software into battery products and customer applications.
* Support integration and validation of battery systems with customer equipment, industrial machines, government applications, and electric vehicle platforms.
* Develop and execute software verification and validation plans including unit testing, integration testing, HIL testing, vehicle testing, and system-level testing.
* Analyze test data and system performance to identify issues and support continuous improvement of controls algorithms and software features.
* Perform software debugging, root-cause analysis, and corrective action implementation for issues identified during development, validation, manufacturing, and field operation.
* Support customer issue investigations and provide technical assistance related to BMS software performance, calibration, diagnostics, and system integration.
* Create and maintain software requirements, design documentation, test procedures, validation reports, and release documentation.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions to ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and product requirements.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related discipline.
* 2-5 years of experience developing embedded software, controls software, or BMS software.
* Experience with C/C++ software development for embedded systems.
* Experience with software design, implementation, debugging, and testing.
* Understanding of battery management systems, lithium-ion batteries, and battery system operation.
* Familiarity with controls development methodologies and model-based design concepts.
* Experience with software verification and validation activities.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in automotive, xEV, off-highway vehicle, or industrial vehicle applications.
* Experience developing battery algorithms including SOC, SOH, SOP, charging, balancing, diagnostics, and fault management.
* Experience with calibration, tuning, and validation of controls algorithms.
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based development.
* Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing.
* Familiarity with CAN, CAN Open, UDS, J1939, or related automotive communication protocols.
* Experience integrating battery systems into electric vehicles, industrial machines, or mobile equipment.
* Knowledge of automotive development processes and standards.
* Experience supporting customer integration and field issue resolution.
* Experience leveraging AI technologies and engineering productivity tools to improve software development, controls calibration, test automation, data analysis, root-cause investigation, and overall engineering efficiency.
