new_jobs.description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**About IDES:**

Caterpillar’s Integrated Drivetrain Energy Solutions (IDES) Division will focus on delivering advanced electrified power train, zero-emissions products/technologies, and the solutions and services associated with these technologies. Focus areas include batteries, fuel cells, motors, inverters, micro grid controllers, charging, energy storage systems, lifecycle solutions/services and integration of components for ePowertrain solutions across industries.

We are looking for top talent to build and scale the next generation of technologies, products and services to help our customers build a better—more sustainable—world. We need self-motivated, intelligent and team-oriented individuals to make our plans a reality. Individuals with high emotional intelligence, humility and openness to discovery will thrive in the teams we are building.

  

**Job Summary:**  
In this **Battery** **Controls Engineering Specialist** role you will be responsible for leading BMS controls software solutions for batteries, for a variety of Caterpillar applications including mobile construction and mining equipment, marine, rail, oil & gas, and stationary electric power. You will provide technical leadership that will shape the future of Caterpillar’s advanced power systems product offerings. You will work with a team of engineers and be accountable for gathering and meeting the voice of the customer throughout development and integration of control strategies (requirements, design, simulation, integration and validation).

Accountability spans the full development cycle from concept to production implementation onto BMS controller. The position will collaborate with a global teams to solve technical problems and deliver on project goals, continually learn to stay abreast of innovative technology, and mentor team members. This role directly impacts Caterpillar's current and future electrified powertrain products

**What You Will Do:**

* Define and document BMS control requirements; design and develop core and application software features based on product needs
* Create common control features using model-based development for various electrification architectures.
* Apply virtual product development (MIL/SIL simulations) for testing, optimization, and performance verification.
* Develop, calibrate, and validate BMS control features in lab and application environments; Provide on-site support at proving grounds and customer locations as needed
* Lead cross-functional engineering teams to implement robust BMS control strategies
* Collaborate with customers and internal teams to understand software requirements and ensure (module/pack design/application) system integration and validation of control strategies
* Protect Caterpillar’s intellectual property and deliver cost- and time-effective technical solutions

**What You Will Have:**

**Degree Requirement** Bachelors or master’s degree in engineering (focus on control systems or mechatronics preferred)

**Technical Excellence:** Extensive Industry experience developing controls software, performance or system validation related to control algorithms for complex systems.

* Expertise in software validation methodologies i.e. HIL, SIL, lab, machine/vehicle
* MATLAB/Simulink (or similar) with embedded code exposure. Proficient with controls model design and Model Based System Engineering tools
* Knowledge of Direct-to-Flash methodology for creating experimental flash files
* Hands on experience with CAN Communication and use of CANape
* Knowledge and experience with Lithium-Ion batteries and/or BMS control strategies.

**Requirements Analysis:** Extensive experience and knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

**Conceptual Thinking:** Extensive experience and knowledge of thinking and reasoning at a conceptual level; ability to identify the critical ideas and interdependencies among system elements that impact performance.  
  
**Communicating Complex Concepts:** Extensive experience and knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, clear language appropriate to the audience.  
  
**Embedded Systems:** Extensive experience and knowledge of embedded systems and their applications; ability to develop embedded systems with varying levels of complexity to control the operations of the machine it is embedded within.  
  
**Problem Solving**: Extensive experience and knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

**What Will Set You Apart:**

* Prior experience or coursework dealing with battery electric power systems
* Prior experience with Battery systems simulation
* Experience with application of AI/ML and other advanced controls techniques

**Additional Information:**

* This position is located Peoria, IL and requires 5-days a week in-office availability
* Up to 25% Travel possible
* Domestic Relocation is available for this role
* Visa sponsorship is not available for this role

Meta is seeking an experienced Cloud Production Systems Engineer to join the Data Center Operations team. Our data centers and the cloud infrastructure powering tens of thousands of servers forms the foundation upon which Meta's rapidly scaling services operate. Meta is at the leading edge of the global data center industry in both design and cloud operations. This role requires a forward-thinking systems professional with deep experience leveraging diverse software tools to identify cloud automation solutions for complex operational challenges with our Cloud partnerships (AWS, GCP, CoreWeave, and other NeoCloud). The ideal candidate performs deep data analysis to prioritize server repair automation in a hyperscale cloud environment, drives solutions through code, and collaborates effectively with globally distributed teams through clear written communication.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Systems Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Identify and root cause systemic issues across the cloud server fleet and drive resolutions to maximize uptime and utilization by leveraging hardware failure data and diagnostic telemetry
* Write, review, and maintain code for diagnostic and cloud automation tooling that supports quality and efficient delivery of production servers at hyperscale
* Own and develop diagnostic tooling requirements that enable frontline operations teams to efficiently manage and repair the cloud server fleet
* Drive the escalation process for Data Center Operations to identify, root cause, and resolve complex cloud tooling and hardware issues affecting fleet health
* Execute operational validation and verification activities for new cloud product integration into the production environment
* Collaborate with cross-functional cloud tooling teams to provide an operations-centric perspective on open issues and contribute to their development roadmaps
* Perform deep data analysis to prioritize cloud automation opportunities for server repair workflows in a large-scale, heterogeneous hardware environment
* Build cross-functional relationships and influence policies and procedures to improve global cloud data center operations consistency and efficiency
* Mentor other engineers on evaluating and resolving cloud fleet issues and defining improvements to tools and operational processes
* Travel up to 25% to support global cloud data center operations and new site deployments

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 7+ years of experience in production systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or system software development for large-scale cloud environments
* 7+ years of experience with hardware lifecycle management, fleet automation, or cloud data center operations systems spanning compute, storage, or networking infrastructure
* Experience developing systems software or automation tooling in Python, Bash, PHP, C, or C++ for Linux-based production environments at scale
* Experience with the configuration and maintenance of production systems, including web servers, load balancers, relational databases, storage systems, and messaging systems
* Experience communicating technical designs and cloud infrastructure decisions through written documentation and cross-functional stakeholder alignment across engineering and operations teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing or operating cloud configuration management and infrastructure-as-code systems for large heterogeneous hardware fleets
* Experience with data analysis and visualization tools used to prioritize fleet health initiatives and drive operational decision-making

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* VMware Certified Professional (VCP-DCV / VCP-NV)

* Systems Thinking: Ability to understand complex interdependencies across network, compute, storage, and identity layers
* Problem Solving: Structured troubleshooting methodology for multi-layer infrastructure issues
* Communication: Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders; produce clear documentation
* Collaboration: Work effectively across Security, Application Development, Service Desk, and Vendor Management teams

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

  

Xometry is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Platform team. This role is a strategic technical leadership position focused on the architectural evolution of our flagship enterprise partnership.

While our current plug-ins function as external add-ons, you will be responsible for re-architecting Xometry's core application services to live natively within our partner's digital ecosystem. You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry's AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero-latency DFM feedback and one-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment.

This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location.

**How You'll Contribute**
-------------------------

* **Software Development and Technical Craft:** You will design high-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs.
* **AI Fluency:** You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real-time geometry analysis. In addition, you'll champion AI-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil.
* **Problem Solving and Decision Making:** You will solve significant and unique challenges regarding data gravity and security. You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry's engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure.
* **Scope and Impact:** You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. You will be a technical and business role model, ensuring that the integration of DFM (Manufacturability) and IQE (Pricing) AI engines creates a distinct, defensible edge for the partnership.
* **Collaboration and Communication:** You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well-documented decisions. As a primary point of contact for senior leadership, you will guide risk/reward conversations and champion cross-functional development across our marketplace and data science teams.
* **Operational Excellence:** You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise-grade deployments, whether partner-hosted or Xometry-hosted, ensuring seamless multi-tenant management.

**What You'll Bring to Xometry**
--------------------------------

* **Experience:** 12+ years of professional software development experience, with a history of scaling complex platforms.
* **Deep Technical Expertise:** Expert-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications.
* **Systems Architect:** Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards.
* **Strategic Roadmap Execution:** A track record of securing endorsement for 6-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment.
* **Communication Excellence:** The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long-term technology investments.
* **Education:** Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

**You Would Be A Great Fit With**
---------------------------------

* **Platform Experience:** Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs.
* **Industrial Tech Background:** Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems.
* **Security & Governance:** Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment.
* **Distributed Systems:** Experience architecting large-scale ML platforms or high-frequency marketplace engines.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $170,000 – $195,000annually + annual bonus, depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, and equity.

We also offer a competitive benefits package, including:

* 401(k) match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and disability insurance
* Generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays
* Maternity and bonding leave
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and other wellbeing resources
* A stipend for catered lunch on Tuesdays and Thursdays

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E-Verify.

**About Forterra**  
  
At Forterra, we are unleashing autonomy at scale to transform the battlefield. Our mission is to build the foundational platforms that enable an intelligent ecosystem to coordinate, adapt, and execute with speed and precision even in the uncertainty and disruption of modern conflict. In an era marked by rapid technological change and evolving threats, we design for flexibility, survivability, and operational dominance.

Forterra delivers weapons, sensors, and battlefield effects through integrated autonomous networks reaching operational areas faster, safer, and without placing human lives at risk. Our systems operate with distributed control, dynamic routing, and real-time responsiveness, enabling sustained advantage across complex mission environments.

**About the role**

We are looking for a product focused Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer to help sustain and develop next generation, cutting edge, safe, and scalable autonomous vehicle hardware. You will work at the intersection of embedded systems and autonomous technology, supporting existing projects, bringing up new hardware platforms, writing firmware for microcontrollers and microprocessors, and ensuring system functionality and safety through rigorous testing. You will closely collaborate with deployed product teams, hardware, systems, and other FW engineers to support and develop new cutting edge platforms for Forterra.

**What you'll do**

Work with new hardware:

* Assist in developing hardware/FW through the full product lifecycle from ideation through manufacturing and support.
* Aid in establishing production line tooling, as well as diagnostics capabilities for existing systems.
* Help evaluate new pre-release hardware and tooling for use on next generation systems.
* Review schematics and provide guidance and feedback on signal assignment and wiring.
* Quickly establish a working knowledge of new complete systems, microcontrollers, microprocessors, sensors, and tooling with a view toward product development.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to understand system architecture, participate in design reviews, and debug issues.
* Perform and support new board testing and characterization with low-level firmware.
* Create proof-of-concept setups testing isolated functions of new hardware.
* Work with hardware engineers to provide FW functionality for production line testing.
* Provide guidance to other teams adopting the new hardware and tooling platform.

Develop FW and SW:

* Develop FW for different stages of the product lifecycle; prototype through production.
* Develop board bring-up FW to test signals, busses, and processors to prove wiring.
* Develop tools in Windows or Linux to show signal states, test boards, and support characterization.
* Develop FW and SW to allow boards to operate as designed in a pre-production environment.
* Implement drivers, bootloaders, and system-level software for initial board functionality.
* Assist to get production level FW loaded, working, and tested on new boards.
* Provide test FW to support product manufacturing and automated infant mortality reporting.
* Develop and deploy test FW and SW revisions to aid in diagnostics of embedded Linux systems.

Testing & Validation:

* Develop test plans to validate processor, memory, and communication interfaces (Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, UART, etc.) to support all phases of product development.
* Perform bring-up and debugging of embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debugging tools.
* Set up and execute final acceptance testing for hardware validation before deployment.
* Assist in developing manufacturing and production tests.
* Assist in debugging fielded issues and providing product improvements.

Collaboration & Documentation:

* Work closely with hardware, software, and systems engineers to ensure seamless integration.
* Document software architecture, test plans, and debugging procedures.
* Provide technical support for hardware and firmware during development and production.
* Implement best practices on documenting SW designs and committing code for other teams to use.
* Provide product documentation required to reach safety requirements, product manuals, test procedures, etc.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in embedded software development (Linux) and product development experience.
* 3+ years working with hardware test tools like Oscilloscopes, analyzers, and meters.
* Experience with ARM Cortex-M/R/A processors or similar embedded platforms.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems.
* Experience with bare metal programming and RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr).
* Some experience with Linux as a desktop or embedded in a device.
* Hands-on experience with board bring-up and low-level debugging.
* Knowledge of hardware communication protocols (Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, UART).
* Familiarity with embedded development tools (JTAG debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers).
* Experience with TCP both on embedded platforms and larger systems.
* Experience reading schematics and integrated circuit data sheets.
* Time management and organizational skills.
* Troubleshooting and triage experience, ability to organize complex debugging scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with automotive or robotics hardware.
* Knowledge of safety-critical software development (ISO 26262, MISRA).
* Experience in regulated environments.
* Experience with embedded Linux.
* Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Bash).
* Experience in Agile environments.
* Familiarity with Quality Assurance practices and documentation standards.
* Experience working with Contract manufacturers.

**As an Undersea Acoustic Systems Engineer, you will ...**

* Lead the analysis and implementation of acoustic sources, receivers, transducers, and/or arrays.
* Develop physics-based models of the electrical, mechanical, and acoustic transducer systems.
* Conduct design trades involving materials, geometry, bandwidth, sensitivity, source level, and directivity
* Plan and conduct laboratory, tank, and field testing to characterize systems performance.
* Compare measurements with model predictions and refine models accordingly.

  
**Qualifications**

* Have a Bachelor's degree in Acoustics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, Ocean Engineering, or a related field.

**Position Title:** **Field Service & Controls Engineer**

**Role Purpose:**

Provide practical first-level support for customers experiencing electrical, controls, drive, propulsion, or system-interface problems. The engineer will assess faults, collect reliable evidence, perform approved troubleshooting and repairs, and coordinate escalation.

- Collect fault logs, traces, measurements, photographs, and operating information for specialist escalation.

- Prepare clear service reports and support commissioning, maintenance, training, retrofits, and spare-parts identification.

- Follow site-safety, lockout/tagout, and authorization requirements.

- Provide controls-related engineering support for upgrades, design changes, and product improvements.

- Maintain correct and accurate records for all Engineering changes.

- Provide superior Customer Service and maintain proactive communication with Customers and Suppliers.

- Resolve Customer issues in a timely and professional manner while maintaining safety & minimizing operational downtime.

**Key Requirements:**

- Electrical/electronic technician qualification, engineering technology degree, or equivalent practical field experience. A four-year engineering degree is helpful but not mandatory.

- Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial automation, electrical machinery, motors, or drive systems.

- Working knowledge of AC/DC power, PLC-controlled equipment, HMIs, VFD/servo drives, industrial networks, sensors, and safety circuits.

- Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical documentation.

- Ability to generate new / revise existing 2D drawings.

- Ability to perform electrical measurements safely, including using an oscilloscope.

- Basic diagnostic familiarity with Siemens and/or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley systems. Programming expertise is not required.

- Methodical troubleshooting skills and the judgment to recognize when specialist escalation is necessary.

- Fluent English and the ability to communicate clearly with customers and interdisciplinary international teams.

- Willingness to travel approximately 25% and attend initial and ongoing training in Switzerland.

- Valid driver’s license and ability to work safely in industrial and amusement-ride environments.

- Must be willing to sign Confidentiality/Non-Disclosure Agreements

**Preferred Experience:**

Minimum 5 years of professional experience in field service, maintenance, or commissioning of industrial automation, transportation systems, amusement rides, or other safety-related machinery. Familiarity with power electronics, propulsion systems, pneumatics, hydraulics, NEC, NFPA 70E, UL 508A, or ASTM F24/F2291 is beneficial.

**Personal Profile:**

A practical, dependable all-rounder who remains calm under pressure, works across electrical, controls, and mechanical interfaces, communicates honestly, and takes ownership of moving technical problems toward resolution.

Location:
Baltimore, MD, US

Req ID: 42180

Date: Oct 23, 2026

The ASR Group® family of companies make up the world’s largest refiner and marketer of cane sugar. The companies produce a full line of grocery, industrial, foodservice and specialty sweetener products. Across North America, ASR Group® companies operate five sugar refineries, located in California, Maryland, Louisiana, Canada and Mexico. In Europe, ASR Group® companies operate sugar refineries in the United Kingdom, Portugal, and, with a joint venture partner, Italy. The companies also farm sugarcane and own sugar mills in Mexico and Belize. The ASR Group® portfolio includes the leading brands Domino®, C&H®, Florida Crystals®, Redpath®, Tate & Lyle®, Lyle's®, Sidul® and Whitworths®. ASR Group® companies also produce and market Tellus®, a single-use, compostable tableware and foodservice product made from plant fibers, including sugarcane.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The **Senior Electrical Engineer** serves as the site technical authority for electrical infrastructure and power distribution systems, including substations, transformers, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), generators, and associated electrical assets.

This position is responsible for developing and maintaining a multi-year electrical infrastructure roadmap, including asset lifecycle planning, equipment modernization, critical spare parts strategy, and identification of future capital needs. * Develop and maintain a critical electrical spare parts strategy addressing equipment criticality, long lead-time components, obsolescence, stocking requirements, and replacement alternatives.
* Perform, review, or oversee electrical engineering studies including load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, harmonic, and power quality assessments.
* Provide technical specifications and engineering requirements for transformers, switchgear, protective relays, MCCs, VFDs, motors, generators, and other power distribution equipment.
* Serve as the site electrical engineering representative for capital projects and infrastructure modernization initiatives led by Corporate Engineering.

* Serve as the site electrical engineering resource for applicable NEC, NFPA, OSHA, electrical safety, hazardous-area, and company requirements.

* Identify and evaluate opportunities for infrastructure modernization, system performance improvement, energy optimization, equipment standardization, and improved maintainability.
* Provide technical support for complex electrical system issues, major equipment failures, planned outages, and significant maintenance activities while identifying corrective actions that reduce recurrence.
* Mentor engineers and technical personnel, promote knowledge transfer, and support electrical engineering standardization and best practices across ASR.
* **Additional duties as assigned.**

Job Title: Software Engineer – C++ / Digital Logic Design

Job Reference #: 526831

Job Location: Burlington, MA

Siemens EDA is looking for a software development engineer to work in the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) division. HAV develops and manufactures emulators for functional verification of System-on-Chip circuit designs. In emulation systems, custom software compiles a circuit design's high level description into a low level binary representation that can be loaded and run on the emulation hardware. The individual that fills this position will become a member of emulator compiler specialists developing the compiler software for Siemens EDA’s next generation emulators.

The Software Development Engineer will have responsibilities in development and improvement of the part of the compiler that analyzes the customer design in order to map it on the emulator resources. This includes analysis of clock and data networks, partitioning, placing and synthesis of logic to support the mapping of the customer design onto the emulator. The individual will participate in design and implementation of new functionality for this part of the compiler as well as support current functionality. The work will be mostly in C++ on Linux. They will write system level tests that use software simulation as well as develop new testing methods. This position will include interaction with other software teams as well as Veloce hardware teams in an international, multi-site, development environment. Candidates must be able to work on-site from our Burlington, MA office.

* BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.

* Demonstrated experience with algorithm and data structure design.

===============================================

Yazaki is a global leader in the research, development, and delivery of vehicle power and data solutions.

  

Yazaki works with virtually every major auto manufacturer globally, and we've strived to maintain strategic and stable growth throughout our 84-year history. new_jobs.title: Staff Vehicle Controls Engineer, Steering
new_jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo's fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and you will report to a Vehicle Systems Architecture Lead.

**You will:**

* Own steering system requirements (EPS and steer-by-wire) for the Waymo Driver through their full lifecycle, covering steering tracking performance, redundancy and safe behavior under faults
* Drive steering architecture and fault-tolerance trade studies, such as dual-wound motors, dual ECUs and leader/follower arbitration, redundant sensing, power and communication, degraded-assist levels and thermal derating, to deliver fail-operational steering
* Define and review steering fault monitors and the self-driving system's response to each fault (detection thresholds, debounce, latching and minimal-risk maneuvers), partnering with Functional Safety on ISO 26262 (ASIL D) safety concepts
* Serve as the technical lead with steering suppliers and vehicle OEM partners: review specifications, firmware release content and CAN/CAN-FD interface definitions, and drive supplier defects to closure across sample phases
* Lead root-cause investigations of steering issues found in HIL, on the test track and in the fleet, analyzing vehicle logs and CAN traces and building Python tools that automate analysis of fleet data
* Define verification strategy and sign off steering for driverless operation, covering steering performance (latency, bandwidth, rack speed, tracking error, tire-limit behavior), thermal and endurance cases, and evidence from HIL, track and fleet testing

**You have:**

new_jobs.title: Sr. Automation/Controls Engineer
new_jobs.description:
It's exciting to work for a company that makes the world measurably better.

We're committed to bringing safety, quality, and customer focus to the business of advanced ceramics manufacturing.

**Job Title**

Sr. Automation/Controls EngineerAs the Sr Automation/Controls Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical expert in industrial automation and controls and executes against the function’s manufacturing and engineering strategy. You will be responsible for understanding, defining, implementing, and supporting automation and controls systems across manufacturing operations. Responsibilities include identifying process and equipment improvements, performing technical and cost-benefit analyses, developing equipment and controls specifications, evaluating equipment suppliers and system integrators, supporting project proposals, and leading equipment installation, programming, integration, commissioning, and technology transfer activities.  
  
You will also be accountable for improving manufacturing capability, yield, productivity, reliability, safety, and equipment effectiveness through development and application of automation technologies. You will support development and standardization of automation architectures, controls practices, and manufacturing data connectivity that can be effectively maintained and deployed across multiple manufacturing sites.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a senior engineering subject matter expert in industrial automation, controls, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Provide hands-on engineering support for the design, programming, integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing equipment.
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis involving PLCs, HMIs, electrical controls, instrumentation, motion systems, networks, sensors, and associated manufacturing equipment.
* Develop and maintain PLC and HMI programming standards, controls specifications, electrical/control system documentation, program backups, version control practices, and other automation standards to improve equipment maintainability and consistency.
* Design, program, commission, and troubleshoot Rockwell Automation control systems, including ControlLogix/CompactLogix and FactoryTalk platforms. Support legacy PLC platforms where required.
* Apply industrial networking and communication technologies such as EtherNet/IP and other applicable industrial communication protocols to connect machines, controls, and manufacturing systems.
* Support machine data collection and integration between automation systems and higher-level manufacturing, historian, database, or MES systems where applicable.
* Apply appropriate OT cybersecurity principles when designing, modifying, connecting, and remotely supporting industrial control systems.
* Specify, integrate, and troubleshoot automation technologies such as VFDs, servo/motion control, sensors, instrumentation, machine vision, robotics, and automated material handling where applicable.
* Apply machine safety principles, including safety circuits, interlocks, guarding interfaces, safety PLCs, and risk-reduction requirements in equipment design and modification.
* Review and develop electrical schematics, control panel designs, I/O requirements, P&IDs, and equipment interface requirements.
* Serve as a key technical interface with machine manufacturers, automation suppliers, system integrators, and other external engineering resources.
* Develop equipment and automation specifications and participate in supplier selection, design reviews, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), installation, startup, and commissioning.
* Execute capital equipment projects and technology transfers to meet manufacturing requirements, including training and technical support for plant engineering, maintenance, and manufacturing personnel.
* Collaborate with manufacturing, maintenance, engineering, quality, EHS, IT/OT, and business leadership to improve equipment performance, reliability, process capability, and productivity.
* Develop technical and business justification for automation and process improvement projects, including cost-benefit and risk analysis.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and replicate successful automation technologies and equipment solutions across manufacturing operations.
* Maintain awareness of developments in industrial automation, controls, robotics, machine vision, manufacturing data systems, and related technologies and help evaluate their application within the company.
* Prepare technical analyses, project updates, recommendations, and presentations for engineering, plant, and executive leadership.

**Job Requirements**

**Required Education & Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of controls, automation, or manufacturing engineering experience, with significant hands-on responsibility for industrial automation systems.

**Required Experience and Skills:**

  

* Demonstrated experience designing, programming, commissioning, troubleshooting, and improving PLC/HMI-based manufacturing equipment.
* Strong experience with Rockwell Automation platforms, including Studio 5000/ControlLogix and FactoryTalk, or equivalent industrial control platforms.
* Experience commissioning automated equipment for small and large capital projects.
* Strong understanding of industrial electrical controls, electrical schematics, instrumentation, sensors, motors, VFDs, and related automation hardware.
* Experience with industrial communication networks and protocols used to connect PLCs, HMIs, drives, instrumentation, and manufacturing systems.
* Working knowledge of machine safety principles and applicable electrical/control standards, including relevant NEC, NFPA, NEMA, ISA, IEC, and IEEE requirements.

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex design issues.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in high-speed digital design technologies.

* Experience in digital and analog circuit board design and test
* Hands-on experience with debugging and testing high-speed digital circuits using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other test equipment.
* Experience with schematic capture and Printed Circuit Board (PCB) layout for high-speed digital circuits.
* Familiarity with PCB layout and design rules for high-speed circuits.

* Must have and maintain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

* Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills with the ability to quickly isolate and resolve issues.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every motion our robots make starts with an actuator, and we’re looking for an Actuator Systems Engineer to help us build better ones. This role is for someone who enjoys the full loop: building a model of how a motor or transmission should behave, rigorously testing this around other industry standards, and then iterating on the hardware or firmware until the desired specification is met.
  
  
You’ll work across electrical, mechanical, and firmware design, and you’ll own actuator performance from the bench all the way to robots running in people’s homes. The things you learn and build will directly shape how safe, reliable, efficient, quiet, and strong our robots are.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Plan and run characterization testing on our actuators, covering things like torque constant, friction, efficiency, thermal behavior, and wear over time, and turn those results into models and specs the rest of the team can rely on

  

* Build and maintain electromechanical and thermal models of our actuators that help us predict robot performance, set safe operating limits, and support the controls and simulation teams

  

* Contribute to the electrical design of the actuator, including motor selection, motor drivers, sensing, and protection, working closely with our EE team and suppliers

  

* Contribute to the mechanical design of the actuator, including transmissions, bearings, housings, and thermal paths, with an eye toward torque density, efficiency, and manufacturability

  

* Write and tune motor control firmware, including current and position control, current and thermal limiting, calibration, and fault detection

  
About the team  
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
  
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
  
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
  
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
  
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
* PhD in EE, ME, Robotics, Physics, or a related field, or a Master’s degree in one of these fields and 4+ years of industry experience developing actuators, motors, or other electromechanical systems
* Experience building models of electromechanical or thermal systems and validating them against test data
* Hands-on experience testing and characterizing motors or actuators
* Experience writing embedded motor control firmware in C or C++, and analyzing data in Python

* Experience designing actuators for robots
* Experience with brushless motor design, field-oriented control, or power electronics

The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, 3D Rendering
new_jobs.description:
Mirage is an AI video company focused on making creation dramatically easier. Our team tackles some of the hardest creative and technical challenges in generative media.  
  
We get to rethink how people collaborate with AI that can actually *do* creative work with them—defining entirely new interaction paradigms for AI-native video tools. We make that possible by building multimodal agents that turn creative direction into edits, rendering engines that composite multiple layers of video and graphics, and generative video models trained from the ground up that create new media when needed.  
  
All of this comes together in Captions, our creative workspace for generating, editing, and designing video. The technology behind Captions is now available more broadly: Tesseract gives any AI agent native video-editing capabilities, while developers can integrate our models into their own products through APIs.  
  
**Explore our work**  
Captions — Our flagship creative workspace
  
Tesseract — Our professional video engine for AI agents
  
Research — The foundation models we build in-house
  
Updates — The latest from Mirage
  
TechCrunch, Forbes, Fast Company — Press  
  
**Our Investors**

We’re very fortunate to have some the best investors and entrepreneurs backing us, including **Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz,** **General Catalyst**, Uncommon Projects, Kevin Systrom, Mike Krieger, Lenny Rachitsky, Antoine Martin, Julie Zhuo, Ben Rubin, Jaren Glover, SVAngel, 20VC, Ludlow Ventures, Chapter One, and more.

*Please note that most of our roles will require you to be in-person at our NYC HQ (located in Union Square)*

**About the role**

We want Tesseract to render 3D that is indistinguishable from footage. You'll be the founding engineer for photoreal 3D in Tesseract, our Rust-based, cross-platform graphics and media rendering engine.

Tesseract already renders video, motion graphics, effects and compositing in a color- managed pipeline. You'll build 3D to the same standard: a fast interactive preview for editing, and a physically based final render, path-traced or hybrid ray-traced, that produces film-quality frames for export. Both run from one scene, material and lighting model, so what people see while they edit is what they export.

Scenes are authored by people and by AI agents, so render cost, failure modes and APIs matter as much as image quality. This is a foundational role: you'll make the core architectural decisions and help build the team around them.

**What you'll do**

* Define the architecture for photoreal 3D: how ray tracing, rasterization and denoising divide the work, and how that maps onto Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D and WebGPU.
* Build light transport: global illumination, reflections and refraction, soft shadows from area lights, and volumetrics such as haze, fog and light shafts.
* Build a physically based model for materials, lights and cameras: energy-conserving materials (metal, glass, clearcoat, sheen, translucency), lights in real-world units, and a camera with exposure, depth of field and motion blur.
* Own image quality: sampling, antialiasing, accumulation, denoising and firefly suppression, with frames that stay stable and deterministic across a video export.
* Scale scenes to production complexity with acceleration structures, instancing, culling and memory management, for millions of triangles and tens of thousands of objects.
* Integrate 3D into Tesseract's video, motion graphics and compositing pipeline, including ACES color management and render passes such as depth, normals, motion vectors and light groups.
* Make render cost predictable and rendering robust: performance budgets, profiling, and headless batch rendering on local and cloud GPUs.
* Design 3D APIs that work for people and AI agents alike: a clear scene representation, actionable validation errors, fast previews and render cost known before the render.
* Work with engine, product and AI teams, and help hire and grow the 3D rendering team.

**What makes you a great fit**

* Deep experience building physically based renderers in production: film or offline renderers, path tracers, or game engines with ray-traced or hybrid lighting.
* Strong command of light transport: the rendering equation, Monte Carlo integration, importance sampling, material models and denoising.
* Hands-on GPU ray tracing: building and traversing acceleration structures (BVHs), hardware ray-tracing APIs such as Metal ray tracing, Vulkan ray tracing or DXR, and compute-based fallbacks.
* A solid understanding of modern rasterization pipelines, and of how hybrid renderers combine rasterization with ray tracing.
* Hands-on experience with Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D or WebGPU, including compute shaders, GPU profiling and GPU debugging.
* Proficiency in Rust or C++, with strong reasoning about memory, concurrency and performance.
* Strong foundations in the mathematics of graphics: linear algebra, geometry, probability and sampling.
* An eye for realism: you can look at a frame, say why it doesn't read as real, and fix the cause.
* Experience owning complex technical projects and making architectural decisions in ambiguous problem spaces.

**Even better if…**

* You've worked on the internals of a production renderer or engine such as Cycles, Arnold, RenderMan, V-Ray, Karma, Unreal Engine (Lumen or its path tracer) or Unity HDRP.
* You've built or integrated ML denoisers, or worked on neural rendering.
* You've worked with color management (ACES, OpenColorIO), HDR output or film-look pipelines.
* You've built on cross-platform graphics abstractions such as wgpu, including extending them where they lack features such as ray tracing.
* You've optimized rendering for Apple silicon or mobile GPUs.
* You have experience with Rust, video compositing, or integrating 2D and 3D rendering in creative tools.

* 401K with employer match

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

**In this role you will**

* Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
* Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
* Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
* Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
* Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
* Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

**Required qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
* Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
* Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
* Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
* Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

**Desirable qualifications**

* ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
* Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
* Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
* Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.

new_jobs.description:
Hayward Holdings Inc. (NYSE "HAYW") is one of the leading manufacturers of residential swimming pool equipment in the world, with a significant presence in the commercial pool market that is continuously growing. Hayward designs, manufactures, and markets a full line of residential and commercial pool and spa equipment including pumps, filters, heating, cleaners, salt chlorinators, automation, lighting, safety, flow control and energy solutions at our company owned facilities. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Hayward also has facilities in Tennessee, Arizona, and Rhode Island, Georgia, as well as Canada, Spain, France, Australia, and China.

**Overview:**

We're looking for a self-directed engineer who thrives with ownership — someone who can take a project from concept through manufacturing release with minimal oversight, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver industry-leading pool controls, electronics, and assemblies.

Join us to lead, grow, and make an impact as part of a company that values care, respect, and innovation.

**This position is based in North Kingstown, RI and is onsite 5 days a week.**

**Major Tasks and Responsibilities**

**1. Design Ownership**

* Analyze system and subsystem level requirements and evaluate technical solutions for new platforms.
* Generate electrical architecture solutions, topologies, and configurations to optimize the electrical design for new project needs.
* Design, model, simulate, implement, and verify circuits.
* Lead design reviews, optimize PCB layouts, and specify components for robust designs.

**2. Analysis and Verification**

* Support electronic circuit verification activities per industry accepted practices.
* Support DFMEA and other analyses to develop a robust product that meets market and safety requirements.

**3. Test, Validate, and Launch**

* Build and analyze bench level prototypes for proof-of-concept designs.
* Create and execute test plans to validate designs and ensure industry compliance (HALT, EMC/EMI, UL, CE).
* Partner with manufacturing teams for smooth production launches.

**4. Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with product, firmware, mechanical, and system architects to create cohesive product architectures.
* Maintain detailed technical documentation and communicate design strategies effectively.

**5. Continuous Learning**

* Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies through conferences, research, and side projects.
* Champion and role model best practices within the electrical engineering team.

**Requirements**

Experience: 8–10+ years in electrical design and product development.

**Who You Are**

* Self-driven and independent — comfortable owning projects end-to-end with minimal oversight and a strong commitment to meeting deadlines.

**Required Experience**

* Proficiency with schematic capture tools (Altium, Xpedition, Zuken, OrCAD or Eagle) and knowledge of PCB layout and PCB construction.
* Experience with IoT-connected embedded systems, including wireless communication protocols (e.g., Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee) and cloud-connected device architectures.
* Knowledge of 3-phase BLDC motor drives, embedded systems, microcontrollers, and analog/digital circuitry.
* Familiarity with safety standards, EMC, and environmental compliance.
* Understanding of mechanical/thermal/packaging design for embedded systems in commercial and industrial markets.
* Experience with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, and timing analyzers to support product verification.
* Technical knowledge of reliability testing including environmental, safety, and EMI/EMC verification procedures.
* Working knowledge of display controller and touch-controller interfaces (e.g., RGB, MIPI DSI, SPI, I2C), including backlight drive and power sequencing, touch tuning for wet, gloved, and high-glare conditions, ESD/EMC protection of the display and touch subsystem.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using simulation and analysis tools such as LTSpice, Saber, Mathcad, or Maple.
* Experience with electrical product design in a regulated environment such as automotive, aerospace, or medical.
* Design For Six Sigma, DMAIC, Lean Six Sigma, or Shainin Red X certification.
* Hands-on experience designing and integrating user-interface displays and touchscreens for harsh, outdoor-exposed products, including full-color TFT LCD touchscreens (resistive and projected-capacitive) as well as simpler segmented, character, and LED displays and keypads.
* Proven track record translating customer and market requirements into product requirements, system architectures, and technical specifications.
* Experience leading or contributing to architecture trade studies, make/buy decisions, and platform selection (MCU/SoC, connectivity modules, sensors).

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) required; Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE) preferred.

**Why Join Hayward**

* **Impact at Scale:** Build the connected, IoT-enabled hardware inside smart pool products used in millions of homes worldwide.
* **Our Mission:** Transforming water experiences with innovation and sustainability.
* **Growth Opportunities:** A supportive environment for career advancement and professional development.
* **Inclusive Culture:** We value diversity and foster a collaborative workplace.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive pay, health coverage, retirement plan matching, and paid time off.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Sensor Autonomy Engineer - Tactical Applications**  
  
**About Overwatch:**  
Overwatch Imaging is an imagery intelligence technology company working to bring sensor autonomy to time-critical airborne search, detection, tracking and monitoring missions. Our Automated Sensor Operator (ASO) software, native to our own line of purpose-built Smart Sensors and as an upgrade for airborne video gimbal platforms, brings Superhuman Vision and Workload Reduction to users of real-time imagery intelligence systems. We fundamentally believe that modern edge processing and AI-enabled autonomy can perform an important set of time-critical imagery intelligence missions better, faster and more safely than humans can alone.  
  
Founded in 2016 in Hood River, Oregon, we support private sector companies as well as federal, state and local agencies around the world with missions ranging from wildfire mapping and disaster response to law enforcement, border security, maritime domain awareness and tactical intelligence.  
  
**Position Description**  
The Sensor Autonomy Engineer will design and implement software and firmware to transform high-level user inputs and raw sensor data into real-time customer intelligence for Overwatch's Tactical Applications products. This engineer works hands-on with prototype and low-rate production automated imaging systems, developing, testing, and deploying real-time onboard sensor autonomy, image processing and artificial intelligence algorithms, embedded hardware drivers, image manipulation software, user interfaces, and data post-processing tools built to perform within the size, weight, power, and latency constraints of tactical operating environments.  
  
**Level Description**  
The Sensor Autonomy Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of complex software applications. They may have a technical leadership role in mentoring and managing teams of junior and mid-level software engineers. They are expected to have a strong technical background, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to make high-level decisions that affect the entire software development process.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Mathematical Modeling & Analysis:**  
  + 3D mathematics, including coordinate systems, vectors, and rotations.
  + Control systems, state estimation, and motion planning.

* **Geospatial Imagery Optimization:**
  + Develop software to geolocate, rectify, mosaic, register, and combine imagery with map data.
* **Software Development:**
  + Design, develop, and maintain complex software applications.
  + Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  + Participate in code reviews, troubleshoot issues, and optimize software performance and functionality.
* **Payload Embedded Software:**
  + Lead code development, version management, and testing for motion control, camera and IMU drivers, and data management.
  + Balance urgent code changes and unit-specific customization with long-term software sustainability and code reuse.
  + Interface with low-level hardware using SPI, I2C, UART, and analog interfaces.
  + Improve error detection, reporting, and mitigation.
* **Software Interfaces:**
  + Develop and maintain connections between Overwatch Imaging payloads and external systems for command and control, external exploitation algorithms, and data export.
* **Software Deployment:**
  + Develop automated build tools to build, test, and deploy software updates while managing dependencies.

**Character Attributes:**  

* Thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced small startup business environment
* Highly motivated self-starter able to work independently and with a team
* Collaborates well in a small team environment
* Enjoys hands-on work and learning new skills
* Eager to learn and solve real-world problems and accept new challenges
* Takes pride in seeing new products reach operational use quickly

  
**Experience and Education:**  
  

* Formal education in software engineering, computer science, aeronautical engineering, robotics, optics or related fields.
* Strong analytical background in physical systems that interact with the real world
* Experience in airborne or space-based remote sensing and image processing; hands-on experience with mid-sized unmanned aircraft and/or airborne camera systems.
* Experience with image processing software, machine learning techniques, and/or autonomous systems.
* Experience with device driver implementation and embedded system deployment.
* At least 8 years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or
* At least 5 years of experience with a Master’s degree, or a Ph.D degree.
* Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

  
**Technical Competence:**  
  

* Strong experience with the following programming languages: C++, Python, CUDA, OpenCV.
* Strong experience with software versioning and branch management and issue/defect tracking systems.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies such as Agile or Scrum
* Knowledge of multithreading, parallel programming, interoperability, and algorithm optimization.
* Knowledge of Control Systems, IMU, and GPS/INS Hardware and Software
* Knowledge of Linux Operating System on GPU-Accelerated Hardware
* Experience integrating AI/agent coding assistants into daily development, and reviewing AI-assisted code with appropriate rigor
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to lead and mentor other software developers
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

  
**What We Offer:**  
  
**Growth Opportunities:** As a team member of a true startup, you will learn by doing and shape our future. The opportunities are limitless for those who want to grow their career.  
**Impact Opportunity:** We work on missions that matter to keep people safe and make the world better, and we do it without bureaucracy at the speed of a startup.  
**Team Collaboration:** Work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with amazing team

Location:

Business Unit: Advanced Measurement Technologies

Posting Date: Oct 23, 2026

Job Description:

The Staff Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the electronic design and development of ORTEC brand nuclear instrumentation and measurement systems used for radiation detection and radioisotope identification. This role involves board-level circuit design with an emphasis on mixed-signal electronics, including low-noise amplifiers, analog-to-digital converters, digital circuitry, and power supply design.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

Electronic Design & Development

* Conceptualize, design, simulate, implement, and validate low-noise electronic systems using mixed-signal, analog, digital, and software development techniques.
* Design and develop board-level electronic circuits for nuclear instrumentation and measurement systems.
* Develop and implement new technologies to address market opportunities.

Hardware Design & Verification

* Perform schematic capture, feasibility analysis, prototyping, PCB bring-up, debugging, verification testing, and performance characterization of new designs.
* Design and integrate electronic systems incorporating components such as displays, touch panels, and batteries.
* Support compliance testing activities and associated documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Provide technical assistance to Manufacturing and Customer Service teams.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure product designs and performance specifications align with overall product requirements.
* Support system-level hardware and software integration efforts.
  

**Requirements:**

Education & Experience

* BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent required.
* 3–5 years of relevant electronics design experience.

Technical Requirements

* Experience with mixed-signal and/or analog circuit design, including:
  + Amplifier circuits
  + Active and passive filters
  + Transistor circuits
  + Linear and switching power supplies
  + Impedance matching and transformation
  + A/D converters
* Experience with digital circuit design, including:
  + Microprocessors
  + Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs)
* Experience implementing digital signal processing within electronic systems.
* Proficiency with electronic design and simulation tools, including schematic capture and SPICE-based simulation software.
* Experience with system-level software and hardware integration.
* Experience designing high-accuracy, low-noise measurement circuits, including component selection, schematic capture, modeling, and layout techniques.
* Experience selecting electronic components and designing circuits for cryogenic temperature environments.
* Experience designing instrumentation for nuclear measurement applications.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

Communication & Professional Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
* Ability to present technical information effectively to customers and employees.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced professional environment.
* Strong organizational, data collection, and presentation skills.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Willingness to take on increasing technical leadership responsibilities.

Advanced Measurement Technology (AMT), part of AMETEK’s Materials Analysis Division, is a global leader in high-precision measurement and detection solutions. Headquartered in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, AMT designs and manufactures advanced instrumentation for nuclear spectrometry, radiological measurement, electrochemical analysis, and electronic signal recovery. Our technologies enable customers in research, defense, homeland security, and industrial markets to solve their most complex challenges with accuracy and reliability.

  

AMT combines renowned brands such as ORTEC, Amptek, and Sunpower, delivering differentiated solutions for applications ranging from radiation detection and semiconductor analysis to cryogenic cooling systems. As a cleared defense contractor, AMT also supports U.S. government programs with custom products and services. With a strong culture of innovation and operational excellence, AMT continues to expand globally, leveraging decades of expertise to drive advancements in safety, security, and scientific discovery.

new_jobs.title: Staff Firmware/Middleware Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Renesas Electronics Americas (REA) brings together the strong financial foundation of a multi-billion-dollar global operation and the flexibility and velocity of a smaller organization. As a result of the combination of Renesas, IDT and Intersil, REA has a deep portfolio of technology, a strong customer base and big ambitions to grab more market share on a global stage. Our engineers, marketers, sales and support teams are all unified in our goal to create an environment where creativity thrives, where results are rewarded and where diversity is valued.

Renesas Electronics, a leading global semiconductor company, is rapidly scaling its AI-focused power delivery business. Products include high-performance digital power VRMs, multiphase controllers, Smart Power Stages (SPS), Vertical Power Stages (SPS with integrated capacitors and multiple silicon die), Power Towers (power modules integrating multiple SPS-equivalents with capacitors and inductors), and power MOSFETs.

Position Overview:

REA is seeking a Staff Firmware Engineer for our Performance Computing Power (PCP) team in Austin, TX, where we develop the most advanced digital power ICs in the industry. You will architect, design, and maintain firmware for integrated circuits that supply power to the largest and most powerful advanced computing platforms. Your contributions will span low level circuits to large system design, and you will see those systems all the way through to high volume manufacturing.

Job Duties:

* Design, develop, and verify embedded firmware for digital PWM voltage regulators
* Write firmware patches to implement new features or apply hardware workaround
* Work with hardware design team to define interface based on user requirements
* Write specification to document firmware architecture and implementation
* Collaborate with validation team to bring up new silicon and debug any issues found
* Develop automated tests to validate firmware on lab bench using test equipment

  
**Qualifications**  

* 8+ years of experience in firmware development on custom SOCs in pre and post silicon environment
* BS/MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering, or related field
* Expert at embedded firmware development in C and assembly programming language
* Good understanding of software development cycle and version control system
* Skillful at interrupt, memory, and performance optimization for real-time applications
* Deep understanding of state machine driven task management and RTOS concepts
* Experience working with hardware RTL design in Verilog
* Proficient at Linux command line and a scripting language such as Python/Perl
* Strong analytical skills and debug methodology with excellent attention to detail
* Good written and verbal communications skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of ARM cortex M-series processors and ARM compiler toolchain
* Working experience with Cadence or Synopsys design tools: SimVision or Verdi
* Solid understanding of serial bus protocols such as I2C, SPI
* Test Driven Development (TDD) and standalone FW unit test bench
* Familiarity with DC-DC buck converter concepts and applications

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.
